  "source": [
    "FUNCTION Z_ORVANTA_CFG_BTE_META.",
    "*\"--------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*\"*\"局部接口：",
    "*\"  EXPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_CODE) TYPE  CHAR40",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_MESSAGE) TYPE  BAPI_MSG",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_READ_ONLY) TYPE  XFELD",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_FRESH) TYPE  XFELD",
    "*\"  TABLES",
    "*\"      ET_HEADER STRUCTURE  VIMDESC",
    "*\"      ET_NAMTAB STRUCTURE  VIMNAMTAB",
    "*\"      ET_EVENTS STRUCTURE  TVIMF",
    "*\"--------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "* 固定只读元数据；不调用产品维护、锁、CTS、提交或业务函数。",
    "  DATA: lt_header TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF vimdesc,",
    "        lt_namtab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF vimnamtab,",
    "        lt_sellist TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF vimsellist,",
    "        lt_events TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF tvimf,",
    "        lt_events_after TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF tvimf,",
    "        ls_header TYPE vimdesc,",
    "        ls_directory TYPE tvdir,",
    "        ls_directory_after TYPE tvdir,",
    "        lv_rc TYPE sy-subrc,",
    "        lv_count TYPE i,",
    "        lx_error TYPE REF TO cx_root.",
    "",
    "  CLEAR: ev_code, ev_message, ev_read_only, ev_fresh.",
    "  REFRESH: et_header, et_namtab, et_events.",
    "  ev_read_only = 'X'.",
    "* SVIX 有原生缓存；返回观察值，不签发新鲜/锁内/可写许可。",
    "  ev_code = 'SCOPE_UNSUPPORTED'.",
    "  IF sy-sysid <> 'GR2' OR sy-mandt <> '200'.",
    "    ev_message = 'Only GR2 client 200 is supported.'.",
    "    RETURN.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "  TRY.",
    "      CALL FUNCTION 'VIEW_AUTHORITY_CHECK'",
    "        EXPORTING",
    "          view_action = 'S'",
    "          view_name = 'TBE24'",
    "          no_warning_for_clientindep = 'X'",
    "        EXCEPTIONS",
    "          invalid_action = 1",
    "          no_authority = 2",
    "          no_clientindependent_authority = 3",
    "          table_not_found = 4",
    "          no_linedependent_authority = 5",
    "          error_message = 6",
    "          OTHERS = 7.",
    "      lv_rc = sy-subrc.",
    "      IF lv_rc <> 0.",
    "        IF lv_rc = 2 OR lv_rc = 3 OR lv_rc = 5.",
    "          ev_code = 'AUTHORIZATION_DENIED'.",
    "          ev_message = 'Standard TBE24 display authorization refused.'.",
    "        ELSEIF lv_rc = 4.",
    "          ev_code = 'ROUTE_UNSUPPORTED'.",
    "          ev_message =",
    "            'Standard authorization check did not find TBE24.'.",
    "        ELSE.",
    "          ev_code = 'NATIVE_METADATA_FAILED'.",
    "          ev_message = 'Standard display authorization check failed.'.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        IF lv_rc <> 0 AND sy-msgid IS NOT INITIAL.",
    "* INTO 仅构造返回文本，不弹出标准权限错误对话。",
    "          MESSAGE ID sy-msgid TYPE 'S' NUMBER sy-msgno",
    "            WITH sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4 INTO ev_message.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        RETURN.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "",
    "      SELECT SINGLE * FROM tvdir INTO ls_directory",
    "        WHERE tabname = 'TBE24'.",
    "      IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR ls_directory-area <> 'BFTM'",
    "         OR ls_directory-liste <> '0090'",
    "         OR ls_directory-bastab <> 'X'",
    "         OR ls_directory-newgener <> space.",
    "        ev_code = 'ROUTE_UNSUPPORTED'.",
    "        ev_message =",
    "          'Registered TBE24 product route changed or is missing.'.",
    "        RETURN.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      SELECT * FROM tvimf INTO TABLE lt_events",
    "        WHERE tabname = 'TBE24'.",
    "      DESCRIBE TABLE lt_events LINES lv_count.",
    "      IF lv_count > 64.",
    "        ev_code = 'METADATA_LIMIT_EXCEEDED'.",
    "        ev_message =",
    "          'Maintenance event metadata exceeds the fixed bound.'.",
    "        RETURN.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      SORT lt_events BY tabname event.",
    "",
    "      CALL FUNCTION 'VIEW_GET_DDIC_INFO'",
    "        EXPORTING viewname = 'TBE24'",
    "        TABLES",
    "          sellist = lt_sellist",
    "          x_header = lt_header",
    "          x_namtab = lt_namtab",
    "        EXCEPTIONS",
    "          no_tvdir_entry = 1",
    "          table_not_found = 2",
    "          error_message = 3",
    "          OTHERS = 4.",
    "      IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "        ev_code = 'NATIVE_METADATA_FAILED'.",
    "        ev_message = 'Standard TBE24 control-block read failed.'.",
    "        IF sy-msgid IS NOT INITIAL.",
    "          MESSAGE ID sy-msgid TYPE 'S' NUMBER sy-msgno",
    "            WITH sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4 INTO ev_message.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        RETURN.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      DESCRIBE TABLE lt_header LINES lv_count.",
    "      IF lv_count <> 1.",
    "        ev_code = 'METADATA_INVALID'.",
    "        ev_message =",
    "          'Native metadata did not return exactly one header.'.",
    "        RETURN.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      READ TABLE lt_header INTO ls_header INDEX 1.",
    "      IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR ls_header-viewname <> 'TBE24'",
    "         OR ls_header-maintview <> 'TBE24'",
    "         OR ls_header-area <> ls_directory-area",
    "         OR ls_header-liste <> ls_directory-liste",
    "         OR ls_header-gendate <> ls_directory-gendate",
    "         OR ls_header-gentime <> ls_directory-gentime",
    "         OR ls_header-bastab <> 'X'",
    "         OR ls_header-texttab <> 'TBE24T'",
    "         OR ls_header-texttbexst <> 'X'.",
    "        ev_code = 'METADATA_INVALID'.",
    "        ev_message =",
    "          'Native header does not match the fixed product route.'.",
    "        RETURN.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      DESCRIBE TABLE lt_namtab LINES lv_count.",
    "      IF lv_count < 1 OR lv_count > 200.",
    "        ev_code = 'METADATA_LIMIT_EXCEEDED'.",
    "        ev_message =",
    "          'Native field control blocks are empty or over limit.'.",
    "        RETURN.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "",
    "      SELECT SINGLE * FROM tvdir INTO ls_directory_after",
    "        WHERE tabname = 'TBE24'.",
    "      IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR ls_directory_after <> ls_directory.",
    "        ev_code = 'METADATA_CHANGED'.",
    "        ev_message = 'Maintenance directory changed during the read.'.",
    "        RETURN.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      SELECT * FROM tvimf INTO TABLE lt_events_after",
    "        WHERE tabname = 'TBE24'.",
    "      SORT lt_events_after BY tabname event.",
    "      IF lt_events_after <> lt_events.",
    "        ev_code = 'METADATA_CHANGED'.",
    "        ev_message = 'Maintenance events changed during the read.'.",
    "        RETURN.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      et_header[] = lt_header[].",
    "      et_namtab[] = lt_namtab[].",
    "      et_events[] = lt_events[].",
    "      ev_code = 'METADATA_READ_OK'.",
    "      ev_message =",
    "        'Read-only native metadata; cached values, not a write permit.'.",
    "    CATCH cx_root INTO lx_error.",
    "      REFRESH: et_header, et_namtab, et_events.",
    "      ev_code = 'NATIVE_METADATA_FAILED'.",
    "      ev_message = lx_error->get_text( ).",
    "  ENDTRY.",
    "ENDFUNCTION."
  ],

FUNCTION Z_ORVANTA_CFG_BTE_META
  EXPORTING
    VALUE(EV_CODE) TYPE CHAR40
    VALUE(EV_MESSAGE) TYPE BAPI_MSG
    VALUE(EV_READ_ONLY) TYPE XFELD
    VALUE(EV_FRESH) TYPE XFELD
  TABLES
    ET_HEADER LIKE VIMDESC
    ET_NAMTAB LIKE VIMNAMTAB
    ET_EVENTS LIKE TVIMF.



* 固定只读元数据；不调用产品维护、锁、CTS、提交或业务函数。
  DATA: lt_header TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF vimdesc,
        lt_namtab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF vimnamtab,
        lt_sellist TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF vimsellist,
        lt_events TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF tvimf,
        lt_events_after TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF tvimf,
        ls_header TYPE vimdesc,
        ls_directory TYPE tvdir,
        ls_directory_after TYPE tvdir,
        lv_rc TYPE sy-subrc,
        lv_count TYPE i,
        lx_error TYPE REF TO cx_root.

  CLEAR: ev_code, ev_message, ev_read_only, ev_fresh.
  REFRESH: et_header, et_namtab, et_events.
  ev_read_only = 'X'.
* SVIX 有原生缓存；返回观察值，不签发新鲜/锁内/可写许可。
  ev_code = 'SCOPE_UNSUPPORTED'.
  IF sy-sysid <> 'GR2' OR sy-mandt <> '200'.
    ev_message = 'Only GR2 client 200 is supported.'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  TRY.
      CALL FUNCTION 'VIEW_AUTHORITY_CHECK'
        EXPORTING
          view_action = 'S'
          view_name = 'TBE24'
          no_warning_for_clientindep = 'X'
        EXCEPTIONS
          invalid_action = 1
          no_authority = 2
          no_clientindependent_authority = 3
          table_not_found = 4
          no_linedependent_authority = 5
          error_message = 6
          OTHERS = 7.
      lv_rc = sy-subrc.
      IF lv_rc <> 0.
        IF lv_rc = 2 OR lv_rc = 3 OR lv_rc = 5.
          ev_code = 'AUTHORIZATION_DENIED'.
          ev_message = 'Standard TBE24 display authorization refused.'.
        ELSEIF lv_rc = 4.
          ev_code = 'ROUTE_UNSUPPORTED'.
          ev_message =
            'Standard authorization check did not find TBE24.'.
        ELSE.
          ev_code = 'NATIVE_METADATA_FAILED'.
          ev_message = 'Standard display authorization check failed.'.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_rc <> 0 AND sy-msgid IS NOT INITIAL.
* INTO 仅构造返回文本，不弹出标准权限错误对话。
          MESSAGE ID sy-msgid TYPE 'S' NUMBER sy-msgno
            WITH sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4 INTO ev_message.
        ENDIF.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.

      SELECT SINGLE * FROM tvdir INTO ls_directory
        WHERE tabname = 'TBE24'.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR ls_directory-area <> 'BFTM'
         OR ls_directory-liste <> '0090'
         OR ls_directory-bastab <> 'X'
         OR ls_directory-newgener <> space.
        ev_code = 'ROUTE_UNSUPPORTED'.
        ev_message =
          'Registered TBE24 product route changed or is missing.'.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      SELECT * FROM tvimf INTO TABLE lt_events
        WHERE tabname = 'TBE24'.
      DESCRIBE TABLE lt_events LINES lv_count.
      IF lv_count > 64.
        ev_code = 'METADATA_LIMIT_EXCEEDED'.
        ev_message =
          'Maintenance event metadata exceeds the fixed bound.'.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      SORT lt_events BY tabname event.

      CALL FUNCTION 'VIEW_GET_DDIC_INFO'
        EXPORTING viewname = 'TBE24'
        TABLES
          sellist = lt_sellist
          x_header = lt_header
          x_namtab = lt_namtab
        EXCEPTIONS
          no_tvdir_entry = 1
          table_not_found = 2
          error_message = 3
          OTHERS = 4.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        ev_code = 'NATIVE_METADATA_FAILED'.
        ev_message = 'Standard TBE24 control-block read failed.'.
        IF sy-msgid IS NOT INITIAL.
          MESSAGE ID sy-msgid TYPE 'S' NUMBER sy-msgno
            WITH sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4 INTO ev_message.
        ENDIF.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      DESCRIBE TABLE lt_header LINES lv_count.
      IF lv_count <> 1.
        ev_code = 'METADATA_INVALID'.
        ev_message =
          'Native metadata did not return exactly one header.'.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      READ TABLE lt_header INTO ls_header INDEX 1.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR ls_header-viewname <> 'TBE24'
         OR ls_header-maintview <> 'TBE24'
         OR ls_header-area <> ls_directory-area
         OR ls_header-liste <> ls_directory-liste
         OR ls_header-gendate <> ls_directory-gendate
         OR ls_header-gentime <> ls_directory-gentime
         OR ls_header-bastab <> 'X'
         OR ls_header-texttab <> 'TBE24T'
         OR ls_header-texttbexst <> 'X'.
        ev_code = 'METADATA_INVALID'.
        ev_message =
          'Native header does not match the fixed product route.'.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      DESCRIBE TABLE lt_namtab LINES lv_count.
      IF lv_count < 1 OR lv_count > 200.
        ev_code = 'METADATA_LIMIT_EXCEEDED'.
        ev_message =
          'Native field control blocks are empty or over limit.'.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.

      SELECT SINGLE * FROM tvdir INTO ls_directory_after
        WHERE tabname = 'TBE24'.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR ls_directory_after <> ls_directory.
        ev_code = 'METADATA_CHANGED'.
        ev_message = 'Maintenance directory changed during the read.'.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      SELECT * FROM tvimf INTO TABLE lt_events_after
        WHERE tabname = 'TBE24'.
      SORT lt_events_after BY tabname event.
      IF lt_events_after <> lt_events.
        ev_code = 'METADATA_CHANGED'.
        ev_message = 'Maintenance events changed during the read.'.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      et_header[] = lt_header[].
      et_namtab[] = lt_namtab[].
      et_events[] = lt_events[].
      ev_code = 'METADATA_READ_OK'.
      ev_message =
        'Read-only native metadata; cached values, not a write permit.'.
    CATCH cx_root INTO lx_error.
      REFRESH: et_header, et_namtab, et_events.
      ev_code = 'NATIVE_METADATA_FAILED'.
      ev_message = lx_error->get_text( ).
  ENDTRY.
ENDFUNCTION.

  "source": [
    "FUNCTION Z_ORVANTA_CFG_BTE_META.",
    "*\"--------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*\"*\"局部接口：",
    "*\"  EXPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_CODE) TYPE  CHAR40",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_MESSAGE) TYPE  BAPI_MSG",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_READ_ONLY) TYPE  XFELD",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_FRESH) TYPE  XFELD",
    "*\"  TABLES",
    "*\"      ET_HEADER STRUCTURE  VIMDESC",
    "*\"      ET_NAMTAB STRUCTURE  VIMNAMTAB",
    "*\"      ET_EVENTS STRUCTURE  TVIMF",
    "*\"--------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "* 固定只读元数据；不调用产品维护、锁、CTS、提交或业务函数。",
    "  DATA: lt_header TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF vimdesc,",
    "        lt_namtab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF vimnamtab,",
    "        lt_sellist TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF vimsellist,",
    "        lt_events TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF tvimf,",
    "        lt_events_after TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF tvimf,",
    "        ls_header TYPE vimdesc,",
    "        ls_directory TYPE tvdir,",
    "        ls_directory_after TYPE tvdir,",
    "        lv_granted TYPE activ_auth,",
    "        lv_rc TYPE sy-subrc,",
    "        lv_count TYPE i,",
    "        lx_error TYPE REF TO cx_root.",
    "",
    "  CLEAR: ev_code, ev_message, ev_read_only, ev_fresh.",
    "  REFRESH: et_header, et_namtab, et_events.",
    "  ev_read_only = 'X'.",
    "* SVIX 有原生缓存；返回观察值，不签发新鲜/锁内/可写许可。",
    "  ev_code = 'SCOPE_UNSUPPORTED'.",
    "  IF sy-sysid <> 'GR2' OR sy-mandt <> '200'.",
    "    ev_message = 'Only GR2 client 200 is supported.'.",
    "    RETURN.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "  TRY.",
    "      CALL FUNCTION 'VIEW_AUTHORITY_CHECK'",
    "        EXPORTING",
    "          view_action = 'S'",
    "          view_name = 'TBE24'",
    "          no_warning_for_clientindep = 'X'",
    "        IMPORTING",
    "          granted_actvt = lv_granted",
    "        EXCEPTIONS",
    "          invalid_action = 1",
    "          no_authority = 2",
    "          no_clientindependent_authority = 3",
    "          table_not_found = 4",
    "          no_linedependent_authority = 5",
    "          error_message = 6",
    "          OTHERS = 7.",
    "      lv_rc = sy-subrc.",
    "      IF lv_rc <> 0 OR lv_granted <> '03'.",
    "        IF lv_rc = 2 OR lv_rc = 3 OR lv_rc = 5",
    "           OR ( lv_rc = 0 AND lv_granted <> '03' ).",
    "          ev_code = 'AUTHORIZATION_DENIED'.",
    "          ev_message = 'Standard TBE24 display authorization refused.'.",
    "        ELSEIF lv_rc = 4.",
    "          ev_code = 'ROUTE_UNSUPPORTED'.",
    "          ev_message =",
    "            'Standard authorization check did not find TBE24.'.",
    "        ELSE.",
    "          ev_code = 'NATIVE_METADATA_FAILED'.",
    "          ev_message = 'Standard display authorization check failed.'.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        IF lv_rc <> 0 AND sy-msgid IS NOT INITIAL.",
    "* INTO 仅构造返回文本，不弹出标准权限错误对话。",
    "          MESSAGE ID sy-msgid TYPE 'S' NUMBER sy-msgno",
    "            WITH sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4 INTO ev_message.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        RETURN.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "",
    "      SELECT SINGLE * FROM tvdir INTO ls_directory",
    "        WHERE tabname = 'TBE24'.",
    "      IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR ls_directory-area <> 'BFTM'",
    "         OR ls_directory-liste <> '0090'",
    "         OR ls_directory-bastab <> 'X'",
    "         OR ls_directory-newgener <> space.",
    "        ev_code = 'ROUTE_UNSUPPORTED'.",
    "        ev_message =",
    "          'Registered TBE24 product route changed or is missing.'.",
    "        RETURN.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      SELECT * FROM tvimf INTO TABLE lt_events",
    "        WHERE tabname = 'TBE24'.",
    "      DESCRIBE TABLE lt_events LINES lv_count.",
    "      IF lv_count > 64.",
    "        ev_code = 'METADATA_LIMIT_EXCEEDED'.",
    "        ev_message =",
    "          'Maintenance event metadata exceeds the fixed bound.'.",
    "        RETURN.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      SORT lt_events BY tabname event.",
    "",
    "      CALL FUNCTION 'VIEW_GET_DDIC_INFO'",
    "        EXPORTING viewname = 'TBE24'",
    "        TABLES",
    "          sellist = lt_sellist",
    "          x_header = lt_header",
    "          x_namtab = lt_namtab",
    "        EXCEPTIONS",
    "          no_tvdir_entry = 1",
    "          table_not_found = 2",
    "          error_message = 3",
    "          OTHERS = 4.",
    "      IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "        ev_code = 'NATIVE_METADATA_FAILED'.",
    "        ev_message = 'Standard TBE24 control-block read failed.'.",
    "        IF sy-msgid IS NOT INITIAL.",
    "          MESSAGE ID sy-msgid TYPE 'S' NUMBER sy-msgno",
    "            WITH sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4 INTO ev_message.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        RETURN.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      DESCRIBE TABLE lt_header LINES lv_count.",
    "      IF lv_count <> 1.",
    "        ev_code = 'METADATA_INVALID'.",
    "        ev_message =",
    "          'Native metadata did not return exactly one header.'.",
    "        RETURN.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      READ TABLE lt_header INTO ls_header INDEX 1.",
    "      IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR ls_header-viewname <> 'TBE24'",
    "         OR ls_header-maintview <> 'TBE24'",
    "         OR ls_header-area <> ls_directory-area",
    "         OR ls_header-liste <> ls_directory-liste",
    "         OR ls_header-gendate <> ls_directory-gendate",
    "         OR ls_header-gentime <> ls_directory-gentime",
    "         OR ls_header-bastab <> 'X'",
    "         OR ls_header-texttab <> 'TBE24T'",
    "         OR ls_header-texttbexst <> 'X'.",
    "        ev_code = 'METADATA_INVALID'.",
    "        ev_message =",
    "          'Native header does not match the fixed product route.'.",
    "        RETURN.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      DESCRIBE TABLE lt_namtab LINES lv_count.",
    "      IF lv_count < 1 OR lv_count > 200.",
    "        ev_code = 'METADATA_LIMIT_EXCEEDED'.",
    "        ev_message =",
    "          'Native field control blocks are empty or over limit.'.",
    "        RETURN.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "",
    "      SELECT SINGLE * FROM tvdir INTO ls_directory_after",
    "        WHERE tabname = 'TBE24'.",
    "      IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR ls_directory_after <> ls_directory.",
    "        ev_code = 'METADATA_CHANGED'.",
    "        ev_message = 'Maintenance directory changed during the read.'.",
    "        RETURN.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      SELECT * FROM tvimf INTO TABLE lt_events_after",
    "        WHERE tabname = 'TBE24'.",
    "      SORT lt_events_after BY tabname event.",
    "      IF lt_events_after <> lt_events.",
    "        ev_code = 'METADATA_CHANGED'.",
    "        ev_message = 'Maintenance events changed during the read.'.",
    "        RETURN.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      et_header[] = lt_header[].",
    "      et_namtab[] = lt_namtab[].",
    "      et_events[] = lt_events[].",
    "      ev_code = 'METADATA_READ_OK'.",
    "      ev_message =",
    "        'Read-only native metadata; cached values, not a write permit.'.",
    "    CATCH cx_root INTO lx_error.",
    "      REFRESH: et_header, et_namtab, et_events.",
    "      ev_code = 'NATIVE_METADATA_FAILED'.",
    "      ev_message = lx_error->get_text( ).",
    "  ENDTRY.",
    "",
    "",
    "",
    "",
    "",
    "ENDFUNCTION."
  ],

* SVIX 有原生缓存；返回观察值，不签发新鲜/锁内/可写许可。
IF lv_rc = 2 OR lv_rc = 3 OR lv_rc = 5
'Standard authorization check did not find TBE24.'.
IF lv_rc <> 0 AND sy-msgid IS NOT INITIAL.
* INTO 仅构造返回文本，不弹出标准权限错误对话。
MESSAGE ID sy-msgid TYPE 'S' NUMBER sy-msgno
WITH sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4 INTO ev_message.
SELECT SINGLE * FROM tvdir INTO ls_directory
'Registered TBE24 product route changed or is missing.'.
SELECT * FROM tvimf INTO TABLE lt_events
'Maintenance event metadata exceeds the fixed bound.'.
MESSAGE ID sy-msgid TYPE 'S' NUMBER sy-msgno
WITH sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4 INTO ev_message.
'Native metadata did not return exactly one header.'.
READ TABLE lt_header INTO ls_header INDEX 1.
'Native header does not match the fixed product route.'.
'Native field control blocks are empty or over limit.'.
SELECT SINGLE * FROM tvdir INTO ls_directory_after
ev_message = 'Maintenance directory changed during the read.'.

ev_message = 'Maintenance events changed during the read.'.
'Read-only native metadata; cached values, not a write permit.'.

{
  "connectionId": "w200",
  "functionName": "VIEW_AUTHORITY_CHECK",
  "functionGroup": "SVIX",
  "shortText": "Authorization Check for Views/Tables (Extended Table Maintenance)",
  "remoteMode": "",
  "updateTask": false,
  "updateTaskMode": "",
  "globalInterface": false,
  "remoteEnabled": false,
  "importParameters": [
    {
      "name": "VIEW_ACTION",
      "typeName": "",
      "optional": true,
      "passByValue": true,
      "description": "Action: Display/Change/Transport (S/U/T)"
    },
    {
      "name": "VIEW_NAME",
      "typeName": "DD25V-VIEWNAME",
      "optional": false,
      "passByValue": true,
      "description": "Name of the table/view to be checked"
    },
    {
      "name": "NO_WARNING_FOR_CLIENTINDEP",
      "typeName": "",
      "optional": true,
      "passByValue": true,
      "description": "Flag: No Warning for Cross-Client Objects"
    },
    {
      "name": "CHECK_ACTION_ALTERNATIVE",
      "typeName": "FLAG",
      "optional": true,
      "passByValue": false,
      "description": "Flag: Alternative Action Type for Authorization Check"
    }
  ],
  "exportParameters": [
    {
      "name": "GRANTED_ACTVT",
      "typeName": "ACTIV_AUTH",
      "optional": false,
      "passByValue": false,
      "description": "Checked Table Activity"
    }
  ],
  "changingParameters": [
    {
      "name": "ORG_CRIT_INST",
      "typeName": "VIMTY_OC_TYPE",
      "optional": true,
      "passByValue": false,
      "description": "Instantiated Table Organizational Criteria"
    }
  ],
  "tableParameters": [],
  "exceptions": [
    {
      "name": "INVALID_ACTION",
      "description": "The specified action is not allowed"
    },
    {
      "name": "NO_AUTHORITY",
      "description": "The specified table/view action is not allowed"
    },
    {
      "name": "NO_CLIENTINDEPENDENT_AUTHORITY",
      "description": "No Authorization for Maintaining Cross-Client Tables/Views"
    },
    {
      "name": "TABLE_NOT_FOUND",
      "description": "The specified view/table does not exist"
    },
    {
      "name": "NO_LINEDEPENDENT_AUTHORITY",
      "description": "No Row Authorization"
    }
  ],
  "source": [
    "FUNCTION view_authority_check.",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*\"*\"Lokale Schnittstelle:",
    "*\"  IMPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(VIEW_ACTION) DEFAULT 'U'",
    "*\"     VALUE(VIEW_NAME) LIKE  DD25V-VIEWNAME",
    "*\"     VALUE(NO_WARNING_FOR_CLIENTINDEP) DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     REFERENCE(CHECK_ACTION_ALTERNATIVE) TYPE  FLAG OPTIONAL",
    "*\"  EXPORTING",
    "*\"     REFERENCE(GRANTED_ACTVT) TYPE  ACTIV_AUTH",
    "*\"  CHANGING",
    "*\"     REFERENCE(ORG_CRIT_INST) TYPE  VIMTY_OC_TYPE OPTIONAL",
    "*\"  EXCEPTIONS",
    "*\"      INVALID_ACTION",
    "*\"      NO_AUTHORITY",
    "*\"      NO_CLIENTINDEPENDENT_AUTHORITY",
    "*\"      TABLE_NOT_FOUND",
    "*\"      NO_LINEDEPENDENT_AUTHORITY",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "* Note 1522661",
    "* - new optional parameters CHECK_ACTION_ALTERNATIVE and GRANTED_ACTVT",
    "*   to check display activity if the update check was failed",
    "*-----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "* Note 1539105",
    "* - write a sec-audit log entry with view_name and planed activity, if",
    "*   that module is indirectly called per RFC and the sec-audit log is",
    "*   activated",
    "*-----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "  CONSTANTS:",
    "    lc_true       TYPE sap_bool     VALUE 'X',",
    "    lc_failed     TYPE activ_auth   VALUE '00',",
    "    lc_no_tddat   TYPE tddat-cclass VALUE '&NC&'.",
    "",
    "  DATA:",
    "    customauth      TYPE dd25v-customauth,",
    "    cliindep        TYPE dd02v-clidep,",
    "    activity        TYPE xuval,",
    "    lv_delcl        TYPE char1,",
    "    ld_2nd_chk      TYPE flag,",
    "    ld_chk_result   TYPE activ_auth,",
    "    lc_auth_grp     TYPE tddat-cclass,",
    "    auth_enh_active TYPE char1,",
    "    roottab         TYPE dd25l-roottab,",
    "    dd02v_roottab   TYPE dd02v,",
    "    lb_ae           TYPE REF TO if_ex_vim_ae_badi.",
    "*-----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "* verify parameters",
    "  CASE view_action.",
    "    WHEN 'U' OR 'T'.  \"update or transport",
    "      activity = '02'.",
    "      IF check_action_alternative = 'X'.",
    "        ld_2nd_chk = lc_true.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "",
    "    WHEN 'S'.         \"show",
    "      activity = '03'.",
    "",
    "    WHEN OTHERS.",
    "      RAISE invalid_action.",
    "",
    "  ENDCASE.",
    "",
    "  IF view_name NE last_view OR view_name IS INITIAL. \"20041230 UF",
    "    PERFORM prepare USING view_name.                        \"1522661/2",
    "    last_view = view_name.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "  CALL FUNCTION 'RSAU_WRITE_RFCTABLE_AUDIT_LOG'       \"note 1539105",
    "    EXPORTING",
    "      id_table       = view_name",
    "      id_actvt       = activity.",
    "",
    "  IF tvdir-bastab EQ space             \"view",
    "   OR dd25l-viewname <> dd25l-roottab. \"viewvariant on base table",
    "    MOVE dd25l-customauth TO customauth.",
    "*   IF X030L-CLPOS NE 1.",
    "    IF x030l-flagbyte Z vim_clidep.",
    "      MOVE 'X' TO cliindep.",
    "    ELSE.",
    "      CLEAR cliindep.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ELSE.                                \"base table",
    "    IF dd02v-clidep EQ space.",
    "      MOVE: 'X' TO cliindep,",
    "            dd02v-contflag TO customauth.",
    "*   ELSEIF TEXT_TAB_EXISTS NE SPACE AND TEXT_X030L-CLPOS NE 1. \"texttb",
    "    ELSEIF text_tab_exists NE space AND",
    "           text_x030l-flagbyte Z vim_clidep. \"texttb",
    "      MOVE 'X' TO cliindep.",
    "      SELECT * FROM dd02l WHERE tabname  EQ text_table_name",
    "                            AND as4local EQ 'A'.",
    "        EXIT.",
    "      ENDSELECT.",
    "      IF sy-subrc NE 0. RAISE table_not_found. ENDIF.",
    "      MOVE dd02l-contflag TO customauth.",
    "    ELSE.",
    "      MOVE dd02v-contflag TO customauth.                   \"SRE 1276656",
    "      CLEAR cliindep.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "  PERFORM internal_s_tabu_nam_check USING activity        \"note 1481950",
    "                                          view_name.",
    "",
    "  CALL METHOD cl_exithandler=>get_instance         \"#EC CI_BADI_GETINST",
    "    EXPORTING",
    "      null_instance_accepted        = seex_false",
    "      exit_name                     = 'VIM_AE_BADI'",
    "    CHANGING",
    "      instance                      = lb_ae",
    "    EXCEPTIONS",
    "      no_reference                  = 1",
    "      no_interface_reference        = 2",
    "      no_exit_interface             = 3",
    "      class_not_implement_interface = 4",
    "      single_exit_multiply_active   = 5",
    "      cast_error                    = 6",
    "      exit_not_existing             = 7",
    "      data_incons_in_exit_managem   = 8",
    "      OTHERS                        = 9.",
    "  IF sy-subrc NE 0.",
    "    SELECT SINGLE * FROM tddat WHERE tabname = view_name.",
    "    IF sy-subrc NE 0  OR  tddat-cclass EQ space.",
    "      tddat-cclass = lc_no_tddat.             \" 'non classified table'",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    PERFORM check_s_tabu_dis_nam USING activity",
    "                                       tddat-cclass",
    "                                       view_name",
    "                                       ld_2nd_chk",
    "                              CHANGING ld_chk_result.",
    "    IF ld_chk_result = lc_failed.",
    "      RAISE no_authority.",
    "    ELSEIF ld_2nd_chk = lc_true.",
    "      granted_actvt = ld_chk_result.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ELSE.",
    "    CALL METHOD lb_ae->get_ae_values",
    "      IMPORTING",
    "        ae_enabled = auth_enh_active",
    "        auth_grp   = lc_auth_grp.",
    "    IF auth_enh_active = 'X'.",
    "*     check enhanced table maintenance authority",
    "      lv_delcl = customauth.",
    "      IF lv_delcl IS INITIAL.",
    "        SELECT SINGLE roottab FROM dd25l INTO roottab       \"#EC *",
    "                              WHERE viewname  EQ view_name.",
    "        CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_TABL_GET'",
    "          EXPORTING",
    "            name     = roottab",
    "            langu    = sy-langu",
    "          IMPORTING",
    "            dd02v_wa = dd02v_roottab",
    "          EXCEPTIONS",
    "            OTHERS   = 0.",
    "        MOVE dd02v_roottab-contflag TO lv_delcl.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "",
    "      IF 'CGE' CS lv_delcl.                  \"Add E type also",
    "*                       It's a customizing table/view         \"SRE 2008",
    "        PERFORM check_s_tabu_dis_nam USING activity",
    "                                           lc_auth_grp",
    "                                           view_name",
    "                                           ld_2nd_chk",
    "                                  CHANGING ld_chk_result.",
    "        IF ld_chk_result = lc_failed.",
    "          RAISE no_authority.",
    "        ELSEIF ld_2nd_chk = lc_true.",
    "          granted_actvt = ld_chk_result.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "",
    "      ELSE.",
    "* Correction for Security issue - DUTTAN 25/11/2009.",
    "        SELECT SINGLE * FROM tddat WHERE tabname = view_name.",
    "        IF sy-subrc NE 0  OR  tddat-cclass EQ space.",
    "          tddat-cclass = lc_no_tddat.           \" 'non classified table'",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        PERFORM check_s_tabu_dis_nam USING activity",
    "                                           tddat-cclass",
    "                                           view_name",
    "                                           ld_2nd_chk",
    "                                  CHANGING ld_chk_result.",
    "        IF ld_chk_result = lc_failed.",
    "          RAISE no_authority.",
    "        ELSEIF ld_2nd_chk = lc_true.",
    "          granted_actvt = ld_chk_result.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "* End of Correction.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "    ELSE.",
    "*     check normal table maintenance authority",
    "      SELECT SINGLE * FROM tddat WHERE tabname = view_name.",
    "      IF sy-subrc NE 0  OR  tddat-cclass EQ space.",
    "        tddat-cclass = lc_no_tddat.             \" 'non classified table'",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      PERFORM check_s_tabu_dis_nam USING activity",
    "                                         tddat-cclass",
    "                                         view_name",
    "                                         ld_2nd_chk",
    "                                CHANGING ld_chk_result.",
    "      IF ld_chk_result = lc_failed.",
    "        RAISE no_authority.",
    "      ELSEIF ld_2nd_chk = lc_true.",
    "        granted_actvt = ld_chk_result.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.                                                    \"IG 1030838",
    "  IF cliindep NE space.                \"client independent view/table",
    "* check for customizing relevant clientindep tables.............*",
    "*   IF ACTIVITY EQ '02' AND     \"update request and",
    "*      ( CUSTOMAUTH CO SAP_CUST_CLASSES OR  \"special delivery classes",
    "*        CUSTOMAUTH CO CUST_ONLY_CLASSES ).",
    "    IF activity EQ '02'.               \"update request",
    "      AUTHORITY-CHECK OBJECT 'S_TABU_CLI'",
    "                ID 'CLIIDMAINT' FIELD 'X'.",
    "      IF sy-subrc <> 0.                \"not allowed",
    "        MESSAGE ID 'TB' TYPE 'I' NUMBER 109       \"no cli-indep auth",
    "        RAISING no_clientindependent_authority.",
    "*     ELSE.",
    "*       MESSAGE ID 'TB' TYPE 'I' NUMBER 113 .     \"warning cli-indep",
    "      ELSEIF no_warning_for_clientindep EQ space.",
    "        MESSAGE ID 'TB' TYPE 'I' NUMBER 113 .     \"warning cli-indep",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.                               \"client independent view/table",
    "",
    "  CHECK org_crit_inst IS REQUESTED.",
    "*>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>",
    "*  check sy-uname = 'FRENZELU' or sy-uname = 'UFTEST'.",
    "*>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>",
    "  IF NOT org_crit_inst IS INITIAL.",
    "    IF org_crit_inst->view_name <> view_name.",
    "      CLEAR org_crit_inst.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF org_crit_inst IS INITIAL.",
    "    CREATE OBJECT org_crit_inst",
    "      EXPORTING",
    "        view_name             = view_name",
    "        activity              = activity",
    "      EXCEPTIONS",
    "        no_restrictions_by_oc = 1",
    "        no_oc_found           = 2.",
    "*                 view_not_found       = 3",
    "*                 oc_error             = 4.",
    "    CASE sy-subrc.",
    "      WHEN 0.",
    "",
    "      WHEN 1 OR 2.",
    "* organisation criterion not relevant",
    "        CLEAR org_crit_inst.",
    "    ENDCASE.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF NOT org_crit_inst IS INITIAL.",
    "    CALL METHOD org_crit_inst->check_oc_auth_gen",
    "      EXPORTING",
    "        activity            = activity",
    "      EXCEPTIONS",
    "        no_auth             = 1",
    "        parameter_error     = 2",
    "        authorisation_error = 3",
    "        OTHERS              = 4.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "      IF activity = svorg_read.",
    "        MESSAGE e755 RAISING no_linedependent_authority",
    "         WITH sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4.",
    "*   Sie haben keine zeilenbezogene Anzeigeberechtigung für diese Tabell",
    "      ELSE.",
    "        MESSAGE e756 RAISING no_linedependent_authority",
    "         WITH sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4.",
    "*   Sie haben keine zeilenbezogene Pflegeberechtigung für diese Tabell",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "ENDFUNCTION.",
    "",
    "",
    "*&--------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "*&      Form  internal_s_tabu_nam_check               ( Note 1481950 )",
    "*&--------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* we need the S_TABU_NAM auth-check in SAP internal systems, also if",
    "* S_TABU_DIS authorization grants the user, to get a trace entry in",
    "* table USOB_AUTHVALTRACE (for SU22 maintenance)",
    "*---------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* 09.05.2011   D033600  ( Note 1587228 )                        7.00+",
    "* - run the dummy check in every system, where the SU22 trace is active",
    "*---------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "FORM internal_s_tabu_nam_check USING pd_actvt TYPE xuval",
    "                                     pd_table TYPE dd25v-viewname.",
    "",
    "  IF cl_su2x_tools=>get_status_su22_trace( ) = 'X' .",
    "    AUTHORITY-CHECK OBJECT 'S_TABU_NAM'",
    "             ID 'ACTVT' FIELD pd_actvt",
    "             ID 'TABLE' FIELD pd_table.",
    "    IF sy-subrc = 0.",
    "      \"it's only a dummy auth-check for SU22 trace, the result is",
    "      \"not needed here",
    "      RETURN.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "ENDFORM.                    \"internal_s_tabu_nam_check",
    "",
    "*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "*&      Form  check_s_tabu_dis_nam",
    "*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* Note 1481950",
    "* check will be performed if the user authorizations for S_TABU_DIS",
    "* are not enough for the action on that view. If the check against",
    "* S_TABU_NAM is also failed, we have to raise no_authority",
    "*",
    "* Note 1522661",
    "* IF the parameter CHECK_ACTION_ALTERNATIVE is active (value X)",
    "* we try also the oposite activity to VIEW_ACTION if the check",
    "* against the given activity was failed. The result of the granted",
    "* activity can be requested over the export parameter GRANTED_ACTVT.",
    "* If the authorization does not match for S_TABU_DIS or S_TABU_NAM",
    "* for one of the possible ACTVT -values the exception NO_AUTHORITY",
    "* will be raised",
    "* ---------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "FORM check_s_tabu_dis_nam USING pd_actvt   TYPE xuval",
    "                                pd_group   TYPE tddat-cclass",
    "                                pd_table   TYPE dd25v-viewname",
    "                                pd_2nd_chk TYPE flag",
    "                       CHANGING pd_ret_act TYPE activ_auth.",
    "  CONSTANTS:",
    "    lc_true      TYPE sap_bool   VALUE 'X',",
    "    lc_failed    TYPE activ_auth VALUE '00',",
    "    lc_update    TYPE activ_auth VALUE '02',",
    "    lc_display   TYPE activ_auth VALUE '03'.",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "  pd_ret_act = lc_failed.",
    "",
    "  CASE pd_actvt.",
    "    WHEN lc_update.",
    "      AUTHORITY-CHECK OBJECT 'S_TABU_DIS'",
    "              ID 'ACTVT'     FIELD pd_actvt",
    "              ID 'DICBERCLS' FIELD pd_group.",
    "      IF sy-subrc = 0.",
    "        pd_ret_act = pd_actvt.",
    "        RETURN.",
    "      ELSE.                       \"2nd try - with update and S_TABU_NAM",
    "        AUTHORITY-CHECK OBJECT 'S_TABU_NAM'",
    "              ID 'ACTVT'     FIELD pd_actvt",
    "              ID 'TABLE'     FIELD pd_table.",
    "        IF sy-subrc = 0.",
    "          pd_ret_act = pd_actvt.  \"1st try for action was succesfull",
    "          RETURN.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "",
    "      IF pd_2nd_chk = lc_true.",
    "        \"try to verify display auths for S_TABU_DIS",
    "        AUTHORITY-CHECK OBJECT 'S_TABU_DIS'",
    "             ID 'ACTVT'     FIELD lc_display",
    "             ID 'DICBERCLS' FIELD pd_group.",
    "        IF sy-subrc = 0.",
    "          pd_ret_act = lc_display.",
    "          RETURN.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        \"if there are is no S_TABU_DIS diplay auth,",
    "        \"try S_TABU_NAM",
    "        AUTHORITY-CHECK OBJECT 'S_TABU_NAM'",
    "            ID 'ACTVT'     FIELD lc_display",
    "            ID 'TABLE'     FIELD pd_table.",
    "        IF sy-subrc = 0.",
    "          pd_ret_act = lc_display.",
    "          RETURN.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "",
    "    WHEN lc_display.",
    "      AUTHORITY-CHECK OBJECT 'S_TABU_DIS'",
    "             ID 'ACTVT'     FIELD lc_display",
    "             ID 'DICBERCLS' FIELD pd_group.",
    "      IF sy-subrc = 0.",
    "        pd_ret_act = lc_display.",
    "        RETURN.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      \"if the S_TABU_DIS check fails we have to try the same with",
    "      \"S_TABU_NAM ...",
    "      AUTHORITY-CHECK OBJECT 'S_TABU_NAM'",
    "             ID 'ACTVT'     FIELD lc_display",
    "             ID 'TABLE'     FIELD pd_table.",
    "      IF sy-subrc = 0.",
    "        pd_ret_act = lc_display.",
    "        RETURN.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "",
    "      \"although we want to know display auth, we should verify the",
    "      \"same check on update level because update is also valid for",
    "      \"display",
    "      IF pd_2nd_chk = lc_true.",
    "        AUTHORITY-CHECK OBJECT 'S_TABU_DIS'",
    "               ID 'ACTVT'     FIELD lc_update",
    "               ID 'DICBERCLS' FIELD pd_group.",
    "        IF sy-subrc = 0.",
    "          pd_ret_act = lc_update.",
    "          RETURN.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "",
    "        \"now process the alternative check for update auth",
    "        AUTHORITY-CHECK OBJECT 'S_TABU_NAM'",
    "               ID 'ACTVT'     FIELD lc_update",
    "               ID 'TABLE'     FIELD pd_table.",
    "        IF sy-subrc = 0.",
    "          pd_ret_act = lc_update.",
    "          RETURN.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "",
    "  ENDCASE.",
    "",
    "ENDFORM.                    \"check_s_tabu_dis_nam"
  ],

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  CHECK_DOUBLE_ENTRY
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       Überprüfen, ob eine Prozess-Schnittstelle, für die
*       kein Länder/Branchen-Filter vorgesehen ist, doppelt belegt
*       wird.   ( Aufruf am Zeitpunkt 05 )
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM check_double_entry.
  CLEAR offset.
  IF NOT tps31-procs IS INITIAL.
    ASSIGN:
       tps31-procs TO <procs>,
       tps31-land  TO <land>,
       tps31-applk TO <applk>.
  ELSEIF NOT tps32-procs IS INITIAL.
    ASSIGN:
       tps32-procs TO <procs>,
       tps32-land  TO <land>,
       tps32-applk TO <applk>.
  ELSEIF NOT tps34-procs IS INITIAL.
    ASSIGN:
       tps34-procs TO <procs>,
       tps34-land  TO <land>,
       tps34-applk TO <applk>.
    offset = 'X'.                "Mandant berücksichtigen
  ENDIF.
  SELECT SINGLE * FROM  tps01
         WHERE  procs       = <procs>.
  CHECK tps01-xlbse IS INITIAL.
  IF offset = 'X'.
    LOOP AT total_s WHERE line+3(8) = <procs>.
      CHECK total_s-line+11(3) NE <land>
      OR    total_s-line+14(6) NE <applk>.
      MESSAGE e021(b!) WITH <procs>.
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.
  ELSE.
    LOOP AT total_s WHERE line(8) = <procs>.
      CHECK total_s-line+8(3) NE <land>
      OR    total_s-line+11(6) NE <applk>.
      MESSAGE e021(b!) WITH <procs>.
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM.                    " CHECK_DOUBLE_ENTRY
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  CHECK_ISO_CODE
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       Is the entry in field LAND a valid ISO-Code ?
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*      -->LAND  T****-Land
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM check_iso_code USING land.
  DATA: iso_code LIKE t005-intca.
  DATA: not_unique.
  iso_code = land.
  CHECK NOT iso_code IS INITIAL.
  CALL FUNCTION 'COUNTRY_CODE_ISO_TO_SAP_ABA'
    EXPORTING
      iso_code   = iso_code
    IMPORTING
      not_unique = not_unique
    EXCEPTIONS
      not_found  = 1
      OTHERS     = 2.
  IF sy-subrc <> 0.
    MESSAGE e028(b!) WITH land.
  ENDIF.
  IF not_unique = 'X'.
    MESSAGE w029(b!) WITH land.
  ENDIF.
  land = iso_code.
ENDFORM.                    " CHECK_ISO_CODE

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  ON_SAVE_TBE11
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       Check name space 'EA-' and 'PI-' for packages
*       Exceptions: IS-PS, JVA
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM on_save_tbe11.
  DATA: l_work_area          TYPE tbe11,
        l_switch             TYPE bbte_ext_switch,
        l_activation_allowed TYPE boolean.

  CLEAR gt_switch.
  LOOP AT total.
    l_work_area = total.
    IF   l_work_area-applk(3) = 'EA-'
      OR l_work_area-applk(3) = 'PI-'
      OR l_work_area-applk = 'IS-PS'
      OR l_work_area-applk = 'JVA'.
      IF NOT (
            <action> = geloescht
        AND l_work_area-aktiv = space
        OR  <action> = original
        OR  <action> = neuer_geloescht ).

*       check, if activation is allowed
        CLEAR l_activation_allowed.
        IF NOT g_extension_exit IS INITIAL.

          CLEAR sy-msgid.
*         call of BAdI
          CALL METHOD g_extension_exit->activation_change
            EXPORTING
              active             = l_work_area-aktiv
              flt_val            = l_work_area-applk
            EXCEPTIONS
              change_not_allowed = 1.

          IF sy-subrc <> 0.
*           -> don't change activation of extension!!
            IF NOT sy-msgid IS INITIAL.
              MESSAGE ID sy-msgid TYPE sy-msgty NUMBER sy-msgno
                    WITH sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4.
            ELSE.
              MESSAGE e041(b!).
            ENDIF.
          ELSE.
            l_activation_allowed = 'X'.
          ENDIF.
        ELSE.
          l_activation_allowed = 'X'.
        ENDIF.

        IF NOT l_activation_allowed IS INITIAL.
*         collect activation changes
*         (notification is done after the changes are saved on DB)
          l_switch-ext_alias = l_work_area-applk.
          IF l_work_area-aktiv = space.
            CLEAR l_switch-switch.
          ELSE.
            l_switch-switch    = 'X'.
          ENDIF.
          APPEND l_switch TO gt_switch.
        ENDIF.

      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

  ENDLOOP.
* Prepare BC-Set activation in event 01
  PERFORM bcset_activate_prepare.

ENDFORM.                    " ON_SAVE_TBE11

*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*     Stores info about Bc-Sets to be activated into activate_applk    *
*              To be called in event 01 (before saving)                *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM bcset_activate_prepare.

  CONSTANTS: c_aktiv(5) TYPE c VALUE 'AKTIV',
             c_applk(5) TYPE c VALUE 'APPLK'.
  DATA: applk TYPE applk_bf, ii TYPE i.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS:  <aktiv> TYPE aktiv_ak,
                  <applk> TYPE applk_bf.

  REFRESH activate_applk.

  LOOP AT total.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT c_aktiv OF STRUCTURE <vim_total_struc> TO <aktiv>.

    IF <action> EQ aendern.                               "note 1466156

*---------------Authorithy check for BC-Set activation-----------------*
*     In that case bc-set activation necessary -> check authorithy
*       Correction "HCG August 2003 due to customer issue 594389

      CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_AUTHORITY_CHECK'
        EXPORTING
          TASK             = 'ACTIVATE'
        EXCEPTIONS
          WRONG_PARAMETERS = 1
          NO_AUTHORITY     = 2
          OTHERS           = 3.
      case sy-subrc.
        when 0.
        when 1.
          message e273(SCPR).
        when 2.
          CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_AUTHORITY_CHECK'
            EXPORTING
              TASK             = 'ACTUNCHKT'            "Expert mode
            EXCEPTIONS
              WRONG_PARAMETERS = 1
              NO_AUTHORITY     = 2
              OTHERS           = 3.
          case sy-subrc.
            when 0.
            when 1.
              message e273(SCPR).
            when 2.
              message e247(SCPR) with sy-uname sy-sysid sy-mandt.
            when others.
              message e320(SCPR).
          endcase.
        when others.
          message e320(SCPR).
      endcase.

*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
      IF <aktiv> = 'X'.                                   "note 1466156

        ASSIGN COMPONENT c_applk OF STRUCTURE <vim_total_struc> TO <applk>.
        applk = <applk>.
        APPEND applk TO activate_applk.

      ELSEIF <aktiv> = space.                             "note 1466156

*      <aktiv> = 'X'.                   "Deactivation not possible
*      MODIFY total.
*      MESSAGE i105(b!).

      ENDIF.                                              "note 1466156

    ENDIF.

  ENDLOOP.

  LOOP AT extract.
   ASSIGN COMPONENT c_aktiv OF STRUCTURE <vim_extract_struc> TO <aktiv>.
    IF <xact> EQ aendern AND <aktiv> = 'X'.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT c_applk OF STRUCTURE <vim_extract_struc> TO
                                                                <applk>.
      applk = <applk>.
      APPEND applk TO activate_applk.
    ELSEIF <xact> EQ aendern AND <aktiv> = space.
*      <aktiv> = 'X'.                     "Deactivation not possible
*      MODIFY extract.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.
  ii = 4.
  LOOP AT total.
    IF <action> = 'U'
    or <action> = 'N'
    or <action> = 'D'.
      ii = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.
  sy-subrc = ii.                           "0: Save; 4: Nothing to save

ENDFORM. "bcset_activate_prepare.

*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM fill_bcset TABLES pt_bcset_ids STRUCTURE scpr_parnt
                USING  p_applk     TYPE applk_type.
  DATA: l_applk TYPE applk_bf.
  l_applk = p_applk-applk.
  SELECT bcset_id FROM eabcsets APPENDING TABLE pt_bcset_ids
  WHERE applk = p_applk.
  IF sy-subrc <> 0.
    REFRESH pt_bcset_ids.
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM.                    "FILL_BCSET

FIELD-SYMBOLS: <extr_wa> TYPE tbe11.
  ASSIGN: extract TO <extr_wa> CASTING.

  CHECK status-action EQ aendern.
  LOOP AT SCREEN.

    IF  screen-name = 'TBE11-AKTIV'.
      IF  <extr_wa>-applk    = 'IS-PS'
       or <extr_wa>-applk    = 'JVA'
       or <extr_wa>-applk(3) = 'EA-'.
        screen-input = '0'.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    MODIFY SCREEN.

  ENDLOOP.

*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM check_double_entry.
  CLEAR offset.
  IF NOT tps31-procs IS INITIAL.
    ASSIGN:
       tps31-procs TO <procs>,
       tps31-land  TO <land>,
       tps31-applk TO <applk>.
  ELSEIF NOT tps32-procs IS INITIAL.
    ASSIGN:
       tps32-procs TO <procs>,
       tps32-land  TO <land>,
       tps32-applk TO <applk>.
  ELSEIF NOT tps34-procs IS INITIAL.
    ASSIGN:
       tps34-procs TO <procs>,
       tps34-land  TO <land>,
       tps34-applk TO <applk>.
    offset = 'X'.                "Mandant berücksichtigen
  ENDIF.
  SELECT SINGLE * FROM  tps01
         WHERE  procs       = <procs>.
  CHECK tps01-xlbse IS INITIAL.
  IF offset = 'X'.
    LOOP AT total_s WHERE line+3(8) = <procs>.
      CHECK total_s-line+11(3) NE <land>
      OR    total_s-line+14(6) NE <applk>.
      MESSAGE e021(b!) WITH <procs>.
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.
  ELSE.
    LOOP AT total_s WHERE line(8) = <procs>.
      CHECK total_s-line+8(3) NE <land>
      OR    total_s-line+11(6) NE <applk>.
      MESSAGE e021(b!) WITH <procs>.
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDIF.

FORM on_save_tbe11.
  DATA: l_work_area          TYPE tbe11,
        l_switch             TYPE bbte_ext_switch,
        l_activation_allowed TYPE boolean.

  CLEAR gt_switch.
  LOOP AT total.
    l_work_area = total.
    IF   l_work_area-applk(3) = 'EA-'
      OR l_work_area-applk(3) = 'PI-'
      OR l_work_area-applk = 'IS-PS'
      OR l_work_area-applk = 'JVA'.
      IF NOT (
            <action> = geloescht
        AND l_work_area-aktiv = space
        OR  <action> = original
        OR  <action> = neuer_geloescht ).

*       check, if activation is allowed
        CLEAR l_activation_allowed.
        IF NOT g_extension_exit IS INITIAL.

          CLEAR sy-msgid.
*         call of BAdI
          CALL METHOD g_extension_exit->activation_change
            EXPORTING
              active             = l_work_area-aktiv
              flt_val            = l_work_area-applk
            EXCEPTIONS
              change_not_allowed = 1.

          IF sy-subrc <> 0.
*           -> don't change activation of extension!!
            IF NOT sy-msgid IS INITIAL.
              MESSAGE ID sy-msgid TYPE sy-msgty NUMBER sy-msgno
                    WITH sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4.
            ELSE.
              MESSAGE e041(b!).
            ENDIF.
          ELSE.
            l_activation_allowed = 'X'.
          ENDIF.
        ELSE.
          l_activation_allowed = 'X'.
        ENDIF.

        IF NOT l_activation_allowed IS INITIAL.
*         collect activation changes
*         (notification is done after the changes are saved on DB)
          l_switch-ext_alias = l_work_area-applk.
          IF l_work_area-aktiv = space.
            CLEAR l_switch-switch.
          ELSE.
            l_switch-switch    = 'X'.
          ENDIF.
          APPEND l_switch TO gt_switch.
        ENDIF.

      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

  ENDLOOP.
* Prepare BC-Set activation in event 01
  PERFORM bcset_activate_prepare.

  ENDLOOP.

  LOOP AT extract.
   ASSIGN COMPONENT c_aktiv OF STRUCTURE <vim_extract_struc> TO <aktiv>.

    ELSEIF <xact> EQ aendern AND <aktiv> = space.
*      <aktiv> = 'X'.                     "Deactivation not possible

    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.
  ii = 4.
  LOOP AT total.
    IF <action> = 'U'
    or <action> = 'N'
    or <action> = 'D'.
      ii = 0.

  ENDLOOP.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

*       kein Länder/Branchen-Filter vorgesehen ist, doppelt belegt
*       wird.   ( Aufruf am Zeitpunkt 05 )
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM check_double_entry.
  CLEAR offset.
  IF NOT tps31-procs IS INITIAL.
    ASSIGN:
       tps31-procs TO <procs>,
       tps31-land  TO <land>,
       tps31-applk TO <applk>.
  ELSEIF NOT tps32-procs IS INITIAL.
    ASSIGN:
       tps32-procs TO <procs>,
       tps32-land  TO <land>,
       tps32-applk TO <applk>.
  ELSEIF NOT tps34-procs IS INITIAL.
    ASSIGN:
       tps34-procs TO <procs>,
       tps34-land  TO <land>,
       tps34-applk TO <applk>.
    offset = 'X'.                "Mandant berücksichtigen
  ENDIF.
  SELECT SINGLE * FROM  tps01
         WHERE  procs       = <procs>.
  CHECK tps01-xlbse IS INITIAL.
  IF offset = 'X'.
    LOOP AT total_s WHERE line+3(8) = <procs>.
      CHECK total_s-line+11(3) NE <land>
      OR    total_s-line+14(6) NE <applk>.
      MESSAGE e021(b!) WITH <procs>.
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.
  ELSE.
    LOOP AT total_s WHERE line(8) = <procs>.
      CHECK total_s-line+8(3) NE <land>
      OR    total_s-line+11(6) NE <applk>.
      MESSAGE e021(b!) WITH <procs>.
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM.                    " CHECK_DOUBLE_ENTRY

FORM on_save_tbe11.
  DATA: l_work_area          TYPE tbe11,
        l_switch             TYPE bbte_ext_switch,
        l_activation_allowed TYPE boolean.

  CLEAR gt_switch.
  LOOP AT total.
    l_work_area = total.
    IF   l_work_area-applk(3) = 'EA-'
      OR l_work_area-applk(3) = 'PI-'
      OR l_work_area-applk = 'IS-PS'
      OR l_work_area-applk = 'JVA'.
      IF NOT (
            <action> = geloescht
        AND l_work_area-aktiv = space
        OR  <action> = original
        OR  <action> = neuer_geloescht ).

*       check, if activation is allowed
        CLEAR l_activation_allowed.
        IF NOT g_extension_exit IS INITIAL.

          CLEAR sy-msgid.
*         call of BAdI
          CALL METHOD g_extension_exit->activation_change
            EXPORTING
              active             = l_work_area-aktiv
              flt_val            = l_work_area-applk
            EXCEPTIONS
              change_not_allowed = 1.

          IF sy-subrc <> 0.
*           -> don't change activation of extension!!
            IF NOT sy-msgid IS INITIAL.
              MESSAGE ID sy-msgid TYPE sy-msgty NUMBER sy-msgno
                    WITH sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4.
            ELSE.
              MESSAGE e041(b!).
            ENDIF.
          ELSE.
            l_activation_allowed = 'X'.
          ENDIF.
        ELSE.
          l_activation_allowed = 'X'.
        ENDIF.

        IF NOT l_activation_allowed IS INITIAL.
*         collect activation changes
*         (notification is done after the changes are saved on DB)
          l_switch-ext_alias = l_work_area-applk.
          IF l_work_area-aktiv = space.
            CLEAR l_switch-switch.
          ELSE.
            l_switch-switch    = 'X'.
          ENDIF.
          APPEND l_switch TO gt_switch.
        ENDIF.

      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

  ENDLOOP.
* Prepare BC-Set activation in event 01
  PERFORM bcset_activate_prepare.

*&--------------------------------------------------------------------*

*&--------------------------------------------------------------------*
* prepare saving of changed data in data base                         *
*&--------------------------------------------------------------------*
* <-- SY-SUBRC: 0 - ok, save, others: - don't save                    *
* SY-SUBRC soll abgelöst werden durch:
* <-- VIM_ABORT_SAVING: space -> save, others -> don't save
*&--------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM prepare_saving.
  DATA: rc LIKE sy-subrc,
        ps_addr_ref LIKE addr_ref,
        ps_transp_addrs(1) TYPE c,
        ps_e071k_tab LIKE e071k OCCURS 0,
        ps_tot_ix TYPE i,
        ps_ko200 LIKE ko200,
        ps_addrrc LIKE szad_field-returncode,                      "#EC NEEDED
        ps_ko200_tab LIKE ko200 OCCURS 0, addr_e071 LIKE e071,
        addr_e071k LIKE e071k, dummy TYPE char1,                   "#EC NEEDED
        ps_addr_errtab LIKE addr_error OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE,  "#EC NEEDED
        new_addr_group TYPE ad_group, object_key TYPE ad_objkey,
        handle_c TYPE ad_handle.
  DATA  e071_loctab TYPE vim_ko200_tab_type.

  FIELD-SYMBOLS: <object_key_x> TYPE x, <addr_key> TYPE x,
                 <handle_x> TYPE x.

  IF vim_adjust_middle_level_mode EQ subset.
    x_header[] = vim_adj_header.
    READ TABLE x_header INDEX 1.
    x_namtab[] = vim_adj_namtab.
  ENDIF.
  CLEAR vim_abort_saving.
  IF <status>-upd_checkd EQ space.
    PERFORM check_upd.
  ENDIF.
  IF <status>-upd_flag NE space.
    IF maint_mode EQ aendern.
      CLEAR sy-subrc.
      IF x_header-frm_bf_sav NE space.
        PERFORM (x_header-frm_bf_sav) IN PROGRAM.
*       CHECK SY-SUBRC EQ 0. "if sy-subrc ne 0 don't save -> exit
        IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR vim_abort_saving NE space.
          vim_abort_saving = 'X'. sy-subrc = 8.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      IF x_header-texttbexst <> space.
        PERFORM vim_set_texttab_action_delete.          "SW Texttransl
      ENDIF.
      IF vim_client_state IS INITIAL OR
       ( vim_called_by_cluster <> space AND       "SW  CSS 80009987/1998
          vim_client_state = vim_noact ).
        CALL FUNCTION 'VIEW_GET_CLIENT_STATE'
          IMPORTING
            transp_state = vim_client_state.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
    PERFORM vim_bc_logs_maintain USING x_header
                                       vim_import_profile
                                 CHANGING vim_bc_entry_list.
   IF ( vim_no_dialog EQ space OR vim_import_mode_active NE space ) AND
        ( vim_client_state EQ vim_log OR maint_mode EQ transportieren ).
      IF corr_nbr NE space AND corr_nbr NE <status>-corr_nbr.
        <status>-corr_nbr = corr_nbr.
      ENDIF.
      IF maint_mode EQ transportieren.
        IF <status>-corr_nbr EQ space.
          PERFORM request_corr_number.
          IF x_header-flag NE vim_transport_denied AND
             vim_actopts-transp_off NE bc_transport_denied AND
             <status>-l_corr_nbr NE <status>-corr_nbr.
            PERFORM prepare_corr.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ELSE.
        PERFORM check_transp_objs_for_maint USING rc.
        IF rc NE 0.
          RAISE missing_corr_number.
        ENDIF.
        IF x_header-flag NE vim_transport_denied AND
           vim_actopts-transp_off NE bc_transport_denied.
          PERFORM prepare_corr.
          PERFORM update_corr.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      PERFORM corr_upd.
*    elseif not VIM_BC_ENTRY_LIST is initial.
* fill corr_keytab for bc-set import log
*      perform vim_bc_fill_corr_keytab.
    ENDIF.
    IF vim_import_testmode NE space.   "testrun for import
      CLEAR <status>-upd_flag.         "do not save if testrun happens
      vim_import_no_message = 'X'.
      PERFORM vim_process_message USING 'SV' 'I' 'I' '154'
                                        space space space space.
      CLEAR vim_import_no_message.
    ELSE.
* log begin of database changes
      CALL FUNCTION 'VIEW_WRITE_CHANGELOG_HEADER'
        EXPORTING
          viewname = x_header-viewname
          bastab   = x_header-bastab
          begin    = 'X'
          clidep   = x_header-clidep.
* save addresses.
      IF x_header-adrnbrflag EQ 'N'.   "only new technique
        ASSIGN: object_key TO <object_key_x> CASTING,
                ps_addr_ref-appl_key TO <addr_key> CASTING.
        IF ( maint_mode EQ transportieren OR
             vim_client_state EQ vim_log ) AND
           x_header-flag NE vim_transport_denied AND
           vim_actopts-transp_off NE bc_transport_denied.
          IF x_header-flag EQ space.   "standard logging required
            LOOP AT vim_addr_e071_tab INTO addr_e071.
              addr_e071-trkorr = <status>-corr_nbr.
              MODIFY vim_addr_e071_tab FROM addr_e071.
              ps_ko200 = addr_e071.
              APPEND ps_ko200 TO ps_ko200_tab.
            ENDLOOP.
            ps_transp_addrs = 'X'.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
        LOOP AT vim_addresses_to_save
                                  WHERE viewname EQ x_header-viewname.
*          <f1_x> = vim_addresses_to_save-handle.
          <f1_x> = <vim_addr_handle_x>.
          READ TABLE total WITH KEY <f1_x> BINARY SEARCH.   "#EC WARNOK

          object_key = vim_addresses_to_save-handle.

            APPEND LINES OF vim_addr_e071k_tab TO ps_e071k_tab.

              ps_addr_ref-appl_field = vim_tsadrv-fieldname.
              ps_addr_ref-appl_key   = object_key.
              ps_addr_ref-addr_group = vim_addr_group.
              ps_addr_ref-owner = 'X'.

* Start Note 1482993 PATIDARP
              IF addr_comp = 'X'.
                ASSIGN vim_addresses_to_save-handle TO <handle_x> CASTING.
                handle_c = <handle_x>(140).
              ELSE.

*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       FORM REQUEST_CORR_NUMBER                                      *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       request correction number                                     *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM request_corr_number.
  DATA: rc LIKE sy-subrc, e071_safe LIKE e071.

  CHECK maint_mode EQ transportieren.  "manual transport mode
  IF <status>-l_corr_nbr NE space.
    IF <status>-corr_nbr NE <status>-l_corr_nbr.
      CLEAR: <status>-tr_alrchkd, <status>-corr_enqud.
    ELSE.
      IF vim_external_mode EQ space.
        TRANSLATE <status>-tr_alrchkd USING 'Xx'.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.
  PERFORM vim_get_img_activity CHANGING e071-activity.  "UF738595/2001
  IF vim_corr_obj_viewname NE x_header-viewname.
    CLEAR e071-trkorr.
    PERFORM get_transp_info.
    CHECK x_header-flag NE vim_transport_denied.
    CHECK vim_actopts-transp_off NE bc_transport_denied.
  ENDIF.
  IF <status>-tr_alrchkd EQ space.
* first get corr nbr for lockable transport objects
    e071_safe = e071.
    CLEAR vim_last_source_system.
    LOOP AT vim_corr_objtab WHERE lockable NE space.
      e071 = vim_corr_objtab.
      PERFORM check_lockable_object USING e071 rc.
      CASE rc.
        WHEN 4. maint_mode = anzeigen.
        WHEN 8. RAISE missing_corr_number.

*&      Form  SET_TXT_UPDATE_FLAG                                     *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
* note, if texttab entry was modified on screen
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_txt_update_flag.

  DATA: lb_als TYPE REF TO IF_EX_VIM_ALS_BADI.

  IF <textkey_x> EQ <initial_textkey_x> OR "textkey not filled yet OR
     status-action EQ kopieren OR      "copy mode              OR
     neuer EQ 'J' OR <xact> EQ leer OR "real new entry         OR
     ( temporal_delimitation_happened EQ 'X' AND "temporal delimitation
        x_header-delmdtflag EQ 'B' ).
    PERFORM fill_texttab_key_uc USING <table1> <table1_text>."#EC ..
  ENDIF.
  IF status-action EQ hinzufuegen.
    <status>-upd_flag = 'X'.           "always both tables must be added
  ELSE.
    TRANSLATE <status>-upd_flag USING ' TEX'.
  ENDIF.

  CALL METHOD cl_exithandler=>get_instance
    EXPORTING
      null_instance_accepted        = seex_false
      exit_name                     = 'VIM_ALS_BADI'
    CHANGING
      instance                      = lb_als
    EXCEPTIONS
      no_reference                  = 1
      no_interface_reference        = 2
      no_exit_interface             = 3
      class_not_implement_interface = 4
      single_exit_multiply_active   = 5
      cast_error                    = 6
      exit_not_existing             = 7
      data_incons_in_exit_managem   = 8
      OTHERS                        = 9.
  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    EXIT.
  ELSE.
    CALL METHOD lb_als->enable_als
      EXPORTING
        view_name   = x_header-viewname
      IMPORTING
        als_enabled = als_enabled.

    IF als_enabled = 'X' AND
       ( <status>-upd_flag EQ 'T' OR  <status>-upd_flag EQ 'X' ).
      PERFORM VIM_MULTI_LANGU_TEXT_ALS.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.                               " SET_TXT_UPDATE_FLAG

*&--------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  FILL_TEXTTAB_KEY                                        *
*&--------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       Kept for downward compatibility only. Never use in unicode-
*       system. Use FILL_TEXTTAB_KEY instead                          *
*&--------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM fill_texttab_key USING enti_wa text_wa.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS: <enti>, <text>.
  DATA: index TYPE i.
  LOOP AT x_namtab WHERE texttabfld NE space
                     AND keyflag NE space.   "all keyfields of text table
    index = x_namtab-position - x_header-tablen.
    ASSIGN text_wa+index(x_namtab-flength) TO <text>.
    IF x_namtab-primtabkey EQ space.   "language key
      MOVE sy-langu TO <text>.
    ELSE.
      index = x_namtab-primtabkey.
      READ TABLE x_namtab INDEX index.   "corresponding field of entity tb
      IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
        ASSIGN enti_wa+x_namtab-position(x_namtab-flength) TO <enti>.
        MOVE <enti> TO <text>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDFORM.                               "FILL_TEXTTAB_KEY

*&--------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  FILL_TEXTTAB_KEY_UC                                     *
*&--------------------------------------------------------------------*
* ENTI_WA ---> WA of entity table                                     *
* TEXT_WA <--- WA of text table                                       *
*&--------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM fill_texttab_key_uc USING enti_wa
                         CHANGING text_wa.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS: <namtab> TYPE vimnamtab, <namtab2> TYPE vimnamtab,
                 <enti> TYPE ANY, <text> TYPE ANY.
  DATA: index TYPE i.
  LOOP AT x_namtab ASSIGNING <namtab> WHERE texttabfld NE space
                     AND keyflag NE space.
* keyfield of text table
    ASSIGN COMPONENT <namtab>-viewfield OF STRUCTURE text_wa
     TO <text>.
    IF <namtab>-primtabkey EQ space.   "language key
      MOVE sy-langu TO <text>.
    ELSE.
      index = <namtab>-primtabkey.
      READ TABLE x_namtab ASSIGNING <namtab2> INDEX index.
* corresponding field of entity tb
      IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT <namtab2>-viewfield OF STRUCTURE enti_wa
         TO <enti>.
        MOVE <enti> TO <text>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDFORM.                               "FILL_TEXTTAB_KEY_UC

*&--------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form CREATE_WHERETAB_NEW                                      *
*&--------------------------------------------------------------------*
* create where-tab for dynamic select                                 *
*&--------------------------------------------------------------------*
*        --> CW_TOTAL        table line
*            CW_TABLE        table the wheretab has to be filled for
*            CW_ENTI_KEY
*            CW_RC
*&--------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM create_wheretab_new USING cw_namtab LIKE x_namtab[]
                               total_struc TYPE any
                               total_txt_struc TYPE any
                               value(cw_table) LIKE vimdesc-viewname
                               value(cw_enti_key) TYPE xfeld
                               cw_rc TYPE i.

  DATA: cw_sellist LIKE vimsellist OCCURS 10,
        cw_sel LIKE vimsellist,
        first(1) TYPE c VALUE 'X', w_namtab TYPE vimnamtab,
        flength_in_char TYPE i.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS: <cw_value> TYPE ANY,
                 <w_namtab2> TYPE vimnamtab.

  LOOP AT cw_namtab INTO w_namtab
                    WHERE keyflag NE space    "all textkeyfields
                      AND texttabfld NE space "with relations to
                      AND primtabkey NE 0.    "entity key fields
    CHECK w_namtab-datatype NE 'CLNT' OR first EQ space.
    TRANSLATE first USING 'X '.
*    IF cw_enti_key EQ space.
*      SUBTRACT x_header-tablen FROM w_namtab-position.
*    ENDIF.
*    ASSIGN cw_total+w_namtab-position(w_namtab-flength) "value of
*              TO <cw_value>.           "textkey
    IF cw_enti_key NE space.
      READ TABLE cw_namtab INDEX w_namtab-primtabkey
       ASSIGNING <w_namtab2>.           "corresp. enti key
      ASSIGN COMPONENT <w_namtab2>-viewfield OF
       STRUCTURE total_struc TO <cw_value>.
      cw_sel-viewfield = <w_namtab2>-viewfield.
    ELSE.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT w_namtab-viewfield OF
       STRUCTURE total_txt_struc TO <cw_value>.
      cw_sel-viewfield = w_namtab-viewfield.
    ENDIF.
    cw_sel-tabix     = sy-tabix.
    cw_sel-operator = 'EQ'.
    cw_sel-and_or = 'AND'.
    CALL FUNCTION 'VIEW_CONVERSION_OUTPUT'
         EXPORTING
              tabname      = cw_table
              fieldname    = cw_sel-viewfield
              value_intern = <cw_value>
*       inttype      = w_namtab-inttype
*       datatype     = w_namtab-datatype
*       decimals     = w_namtab-decimals
*       convexit     = w_namtab-convexit
*       sign         = w_namtab-sign
              outputlen    = w_namtab-outputlen
              intlen       = w_namtab-flength
         IMPORTING
              value_extern = cw_sel-value.
    IF cw_sel-value EQ space.
      cw_sel-initial = 'X'.
    ENDIF.
    flength_in_char =
                  w_namtab-flength / cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize.
    CASE w_namtab-inttype.
      WHEN 'F'. cw_sel-fltp_value = <cw_value>.
      WHEN 'D'. cw_sel-date_value = <cw_value>.
      WHEN 'T'. cw_sel-time_value = <cw_value>.
*      WHEN 'P'. cw_sel-pckd_value(w_namtab-flength) = <cw_value>.
      WHEN 'P'. cw_sel-raw_value(w_namtab-flength) = <cw_value>.
      WHEN 'N'. cw_sel-numc_value(flength_in_char) = <cw_value>.
      WHEN 'C'. cw_sel-invd_value(flength_in_char) = <cw_value>.
      WHEN 'I'. cw_sel-int4_value = <cw_value>.
      WHEN 'X'.
        CASE w_namtab-datatype.
          WHEN 'INT1'. cw_sel-int1_value = <cw_value>.
          WHEN 'INT2'. cw_sel-int2_value = <cw_value>.
          WHEN 'INT4'. cw_sel-int4_value = <cw_value>.
          WHEN 'RAW'. cw_sel-raw_value(w_namtab-flength) = <cw_value>.
        ENDCASE.
    ENDCASE.
    cw_sel-converted = 'X'.
    APPEND cw_sel TO cw_sellist.
    CLEAR cw_sel.
  ENDLOOP.
  DESCRIBE TABLE cw_sellist.
  READ TABLE cw_sellist INTO cw_sel INDEX sy-tfill.
  IF cw_sel-and_or NE space.
    CLEAR cw_sel-and_or. MODIFY cw_sellist INDEX sy-tfill FROM cw_sel.
  ENDIF.
  CALL FUNCTION 'VIEW_FILL_WHERETAB'
    EXPORTING
      tablename               = cw_table
      only_cnds_for_keyflds   = 'X'
    TABLES
      sellist                 = cw_sellist
      wheretab                = vim_wheretab
      x_namtab                = cw_namtab
    EXCEPTIONS
      no_conditions_for_table = 01.
  cw_rc = sy-subrc.
ENDFORM.                               "create_wheretab_new

*&--------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  TABLEFRAME                                              *
*&--------------------------------------------------------------------*
* program for function TABLEFRAME_<area>                              *
*&--------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM  tableframe TABLES header STRUCTURE vimdesc
                        namtab STRUCTURE vimnamtab
                        dbasellist STRUCTURE vimsellist
                        dplsellist STRUCTURE vimsellist
                        exclcuafunct STRUCTURE vimexclfun
                 USING  corrnumber
                        viewaction
                        viewname.                                        "#EC NEEDED

  DATA: enqueue_processed TYPE c, "flag: view enqueued by VIEWFRAME_..
        table_type(11) TYPE c,         "type of table to use
        table_length TYPE i.           "length of current table

*-<<<-------------------------------------------------------------->>>>*
* first of all: determine well-sized internal tables etc.              *
*-<<<-------------------------------------------------------------->>>>*
  READ TABLE header INDEX 1.
  table_length = header-tablen / cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize + 2.
*  tab lg. + action + mark
  IF header-texttbexst NE space.
    table_length = table_length
     + header-texttablen / cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize + 1.
* txtb+txtact
  ENDIF.
  IF table_length LE ultra_short_tab.
    MOVE 'ULTRA_SHORT'     TO table_type.
    FREE: extract_vs, total_vs,
          extract_s, total_s,
          extract_m, total_m,
          extract_l, total_l,
          extract_vl, total_vl,
          extract_ul, total_ul.
  ELSEIF table_length LE very_short_tab.
    MOVE 'VERY_SHORT'     TO table_type.
    FREE: extract_us, total_us,
          extract_s, total_s,
          extract_m, total_m,
          extract_l, total_l,
          extract_vl, total_vl,
          extract_ul, total_ul.
  ELSEIF table_length LE short_tab.
    MOVE 'SHORT'     TO table_type.
    FREE: extract_us, total_us,
          extract_vs, total_vs,
          extract_m, total_m,
          extract_l, total_l,
          extract_vl, total_vl,
          extract_ul, total_ul.
  ELSEIF table_length LE middle_tab.
    MOVE 'MIDDLE'    TO table_type.
    FREE: extract_us, total_us,
          extract_vs, total_vs,
          extract_s, total_s,
          extract_l, total_l,
          extract_vl, total_vl,
          extract_ul, total_ul.
  ELSEIF table_length LE long_tab.
    MOVE 'LONG'    TO table_type.
    FREE: extract_us, total_us,
          extract_vs, total_vs,
          extract_s, total_s,
          extract_m, total_m,
          extract_vl, total_vl,
          extract_ul, total_ul.
  ELSEIF table_length LE very_long_tab.
    MOVE 'VERY_LONG'    TO table_type.
    FREE: extract_us, total_us,
          extract_vs, total_vs,
          extract_s, total_s,
          extract_m, total_m,
          extract_l, total_l,
          extract_ul, total_ul.
