  "source": [
    "FUNCTION view_maintenance_low_level.",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*\"*\"Lokale Schnittstelle:",
    "*\"  IMPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(CORR_NUMBER) LIKE  E070-TRKORR DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(FCODE) DEFAULT 'RDED'",
    "*\"     VALUE(VIEW_ACTION) DEFAULT 'S'",
    "*\"     VALUE(VIEW_NAME) LIKE  DD02V-TABNAME",
    "*\"     VALUE(RFC_DESTINATION_FOR_UPGRADE) LIKE  RFCDES-RFCDEST DEFAULT",
    "*\"       ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(CLIENT_FOR_UPGRADE) LIKE  SY-MANDT DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(COMPLEX_SELCONDS_USED) LIKE  TVDIR-FLAG DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(NO_WARNING_FOR_CLIENTINDEP) DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     REFERENCE(OC_INST) TYPE REF TO  CL_VIEWFIELDS_ORG_CRIT OPTIONAL",
    "*\"  EXPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(LAST_ACT_ENTRY) LIKE  SY-TABIX",
    "*\"     VALUE(UCOMM)",
    "*\"     VALUE(UPDATE_REQUIRED)",
    "*\"     VALUE(CORR_NUMBER) LIKE  E070-TRKORR",
    "*\"     VALUE(ACTION_OUT) TYPE  SYCHAR01",
    "*\"  TABLES",
    "*\"      CORR_KEYTAB STRUCTURE  E071K",
    "*\"      DBA_SELLIST STRUCTURE  VIMSELLIST",
    "*\"      DPL_SELLIST STRUCTURE  VIMSELLIST",
    "*\"      EXCL_CUA_FUNCT STRUCTURE  VIMEXCLFUN",
    "*\"      EXTRACT",
    "*\"      TOTAL",
    "*\"      X_HEADER STRUCTURE  VIMDESC",
    "*\"      X_NAMTAB STRUCTURE  VIMNAMTAB",
    "*\"  EXCEPTIONS",
    "*\"      FUNCTION_NOT_FOUND",
    "*\"      MISSING_CORR_NUMBER",
    "*\"      NO_VALUE_FOR_SUBSET_IDENT",
    "*\"      SAVING_CORRECTION_FAILED",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* data declarations                                                    *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "  DATA: function_name(35) TYPE c,",
    "        view_fct_pref(35) TYPE c VALUE 'VIEWPROC_',         \"09 Zeichen",
    "        tabl_fct_pref(35) TYPE c VALUE 'TABLEPROC_',        \"10 Zeichen",
    "*     FPOOL LIKE TRDIR-NAME VALUE 'SAPL    ', RC LIKE SY-SUBRC,",
    "        fpool LIKE trdir-name, rc LIKE sy-subrc,",
    "        length LIKE sy-fdpos, calmode_safe(1) TYPE c,",
    "        specmode_safe(1) TYPE c, specfunctions(4) TYPE c,",
    "        calcls_safe TYPE vcl_name,",
    "      read_texttab(1) TYPE c.                                \"SW Textimp",
    "  FIELD-SYMBOLS: <function_name>.",
    "",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* build function name form view/table name and related prefix          *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "  READ TABLE x_header INDEX 1.",
    "  IF x_header-bastab EQ space.",
    "    MOVE: view_fct_pref TO function_name,",
    "          x_header-maintview TO function_name+9.         \".. Subviews",
    "  ELSE.",
    "    MOVE: tabl_fct_pref TO function_name,",
    "          x_header-area TO function_name+10.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF function_name CA forbidden_func_name_chars.",
    "    PERFORM replace_forbidden_chars USING forbidden_func_name_chars",
    "                                          function_name.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* check if function to call exists in library                          *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "  length = STRLEN( function_name ).",
    "  ASSIGN function_name(length) TO <function_name>.",
    "  READ TABLE alr_checked_views WITH KEY = x_header-viewname",
    "                               BINARY SEARCH",
    "                               TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.",
    "  IF sy-subrc NE 0.",
    "    SELECT SINGLE * FROM tfdir WHERE funcname EQ <function_name>.",
    "    IF sy-subrc NE 0.",
    "      RAISE function_not_found.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    INSERT x_header-viewname INTO alr_checked_views INDEX sy-tabix.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* initialize RFC-destination for current view/table                    *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "  fpool   = x_header-fpoolname.",
    "  vim_default_rfc_dest-viewname = x_header-viewname.",
    "  vim_default_rfc_dest-rfcdest  = rfc_destination_for_upgrade.",
    "  PERFORM vim_set_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool)",
    "            USING 'VIM_DEFAULT_RFC_DEST' 'C' vim_default_rfc_dest rc.",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* initialize client for upgrade for current view/table                 *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "  vim_default_upgr_clnt-viewname = x_header-viewname.",
    "  vim_default_upgr_clnt-client  = client_for_upgrade.",
    "  PERFORM vim_set_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool)",
    "            USING 'VIM_DEFAULT_UPGR_CLNT' 'C' vim_default_upgr_clnt rc.",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* set flag if called by viewcluster maintenance                        *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "  PERFORM vim_get_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool)",
    "            USING 'VIM_CALLED_BY_CLUSTER' 'C' calmode_safe rc.",
    "  PERFORM vim_get_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool)",
    "            USING 'VIM_CALLING_CLUSTER' 'C' calcls_safe rc.",
    "  IF called_by_cluster NE calmode_safe.",
    "    PERFORM vim_set_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool)",
    "              USING 'VIM_CALLED_BY_CLUSTER' 'C' called_by_cluster rc.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF calling_cluster NE calcls_safe.",
    "    PERFORM vim_set_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool)",
    "              USING 'VIM_CALLING_CLUSTER' 'C' calling_cluster rc.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* set variables if special functions requested                         *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "  IF fcode = vim_read_text.                               \"SW Textimp ..",
    "    fcode = read.",
    "    IF x_header-texttbexst <> space.",
    "      read_texttab = 'X'.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.                                                  \".. SW Textimp",
    "  IF fcode EQ 'EXED' OR fcode EQ 'COMP'.",
    "    PERFORM vim_get_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool)",
    "              USING 'VIM_SPECIAL_MODE' 'C' specmode_safe rc.",
    "    CASE fcode.",
    "      WHEN 'EXED'.",
    "        PERFORM vim_set_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool)",
    "                  USING 'VIM_SPECIAL_MODE' 'C' vim_extedit rc.",
    "      WHEN 'COMP'.",
    "        PERFORM vim_set_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool)",
    "                  USING 'VIM_SPECIAL_MODE' 'C' vim_direct_upgrade rc.",
    "    ENDCASE.",
    "    specfunctions = fcode. fcode = edit.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* set flag if complex selection conditions in sellist                  *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "  IF complex_selconds_used NE space.",
    "    READ TABLE dba_sellist INDEX 1.",
    "    IF sy-subrc EQ 0 AND dba_sellist-cond_kind EQ space.",
    "      dba_sellist-cond_kind = 'C'. MODIFY dba_sellist INDEX 1.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    READ TABLE dpl_sellist INDEX 1.",
    "    IF sy-subrc EQ 0 AND dpl_sellist-cond_kind EQ space.",
    "      dpl_sellist-cond_kind = 'C'. MODIFY dpl_sellist INDEX 1.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* forward NO_WARNING... flag                                           *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "  PERFORM vim_set_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool)",
    "     USING 'VIM_NO_WARNING_FOR_CLIINDEP' 'C' no_warning_for_clientindep",
    "           rc.",
    "  PERFORM vim_set_oc IN PROGRAM (fpool) USING oc_inst.",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* call requested function                                              *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "  CALL FUNCTION <function_name>",
    "    EXPORTING",
    "      fcode                     = fcode",
    "      view_action               = view_action",
    "      view_name                 = view_name",
    "      corr_number               = corr_number",
    "    IMPORTING",
    "      last_act_entry            = last_act_entry",
    "      ucomm                     = ucomm",
    "      update_required           = update_required",
    "    TABLES",
    "      corr_keytab               = corr_keytab",
    "      dba_sellist               = dba_sellist",
    "      dpl_sellist               = dpl_sellist",
    "      excl_cua_funct            = excl_cua_funct",
    "      extract                   = extract",
    "      total                     = total",
    "      x_header                  = x_header",
    "      x_namtab                  = x_namtab",
    "    EXCEPTIONS",
    "      missing_corr_number       = 01",
    "      no_value_for_subset_ident = 02",
    "      saving_correction_failed  = 03.",
    "  CASE sy-subrc.",
    "    WHEN 1.",
    "      RAISE missing_corr_number.",
    "    WHEN 2.",
    "      RAISE no_value_for_subset_ident.",
    "    WHEN 3.",
    "      IF vim_import_profile NE space.\"HCG delete for next BC-Set object",
    "        CLEAR: called_by_cluster, calling_cluster.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      RAISE saving_correction_failed.",
    "  ENDCASE.",
    "",
    "  IF read_texttab = 'X'.                                  \"SW Textimp ..",
    "    CALL FUNCTION <function_name>",
    "      EXPORTING",
    "        fcode                     = vim_read_text",
    "        view_action               = view_action",
    "        view_name                 = view_name",
    "        corr_number               = corr_number",
    "      IMPORTING",
    "        last_act_entry            = last_act_entry",
    "        ucomm                     = ucomm",
    "        update_required           = update_required",
    "      TABLES",
    "        corr_keytab               = corr_keytab",
    "        dba_sellist               = dba_sellist",
    "        dpl_sellist               = dpl_sellist",
    "        excl_cua_funct            = excl_cua_funct",
    "        extract                   = extract",
    "        total                     = total",
    "        x_header                  = x_header",
    "        x_namtab                  = x_namtab",
    "      EXCEPTIONS",
    "        missing_corr_number       = 01",
    "        no_value_for_subset_ident = 02",
    "        saving_correction_failed  = 03.",
    "    CASE sy-subrc.",
    "      WHEN 1.",
    "        RAISE missing_corr_number.",
    "      WHEN 2.",
    "        RAISE no_value_for_subset_ident.",
    "      WHEN 3.",
    "        RAISE saving_correction_failed.",
    "    ENDCASE.",
    "  ENDIF.                                                  \".. SW Textimp",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* get new export parameters                                            *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "  PERFORM vim_get_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool)",
    "            USING '<STATUS>-CORR_NBR' 'C' corr_number rc.",
    "  PERFORM vim_get_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool)",
    "            USING 'MAINT_MODE' 'C' action_out rc.",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* reset flag if called by viewcluster maintenance                      *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "  IF called_by_cluster NE calmode_safe.",
    "    PERFORM vim_set_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool)",
    "              USING 'VIM_CALLED_BY_CLUSTER' 'C' calmode_safe rc.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF calling_cluster NE calcls_safe.",
    "    PERFORM vim_set_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool)",
    "              USING 'VIM_CALLING_CLUSTER' 'C' calcls_safe rc.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  CLEAR: called_by_cluster, calling_cluster.",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* reset variables if special functions requested                       *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "  CASE specfunctions.",
    "    WHEN 'EXED'.",
    "      PERFORM vim_set_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool)",
    "                USING 'VIM_SPECIAL_MODE' 'C' specmode_safe rc.",
    "  ENDCASE.",
    "ENDFUNCTION."
  ],

    "FUNCTION view_get_data.",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*\"*\"Lokale Schnittstelle:",
    "*\"  IMPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(VIEW_NAME) LIKE  DD02V-TABNAME",
    "*\"     VALUE(WITHOUT_SUBSET) LIKE  TVDIR-FLAG DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(WITHOUT_EXITS) LIKE  TVDIR-FLAG DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(COMPLEX_SELCONDS_USED) LIKE  TVDIR-FLAG DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(WITH_AUTHORITY_CHECK) LIKE  TVDIR-FLAG DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     REFERENCE(CHECK_LINEDEP_AUTH) TYPE  XFELD DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(DATA_CONT_TYPE_X) TYPE  XFELD DEFAULT SPACE",
    "*\"  TABLES",
    "*\"      DBA_SELLIST STRUCTURE  VIMSELLIST OPTIONAL",
    "*\"      DATA",
    "*\"      X_HEADER STRUCTURE  VIMDESC OPTIONAL",
    "*\"      X_NAMTAB STRUCTURE  VIMNAMTAB OPTIONAL",
    "*\"  CHANGING",
    "*\"     REFERENCE(ORG_CRIT_INST) TYPE  VIMTY_OC_TYPE OPTIONAL",
    "*\"  EXCEPTIONS",
    "*\"      NO_VIEWMAINT_TOOL",
    "*\"      NO_AUTHORITY",
    "*\"      NO_AUTH_FOR_SEL",
    "*\"      DATA_ACCESS_RESTRICTED",
    "*\"      NO_FUNCTIONGROUP",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*      with char data container due to problems of viewmaintenance",
    "*      modifications with hex total[].",
    "************************************************************************",
    "  CONSTANTS: ext_suffix(10) TYPE c VALUE '_EXTRACT[]',",
    "             tot_suffix(8) TYPE c VALUE '_TOTAL[]',",
    "             maxsellines TYPE i VALUE 500.",
    " DATA: icorrkeytab LIKE e071k OCCURS 0, iexfun LIKE vimexclfun OCCURS 0,",
    "                 isellist LIKE vimsellist OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE,",
    "                 header LIKE vimdesc OCCURS 1 WITH HEADER LINE,",
    "                 namtab LIKE vimnamtab OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE,",
    "                 iex(4096) TYPE c OCCURS 0, x(1) TYPE c VALUE 'X',",
    "             s(1) TYPE c VALUE 'S', rfc_destination LIKE rfcdes-rfcdest,",
    "            dd_selcond_lines LIKE sy-tfill,\"Anzahl Selektionsbed. aus DD",
    "      usr_selcond_lines LIKE sy-tfill, \"Anzahl übergebene Selektionsbed.",
    "               ix031l LIKE x031l OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE,",
    "                 fnam LIKE d021s-fnam, corr_number LIKE e070-trkorr, \"#EC NEEDED",
    "           upd_requ(1) TYPE c, tot_name(40) TYPE c, ext_name(40) TYPE c,",
    "                table_length TYPE i, x_table_length TYPE i, h_ix TYPE i,",
    "          dummytc TYPE vimty_tcode, results LIKE vimmodres, n_ix TYPE i,",
    "                 import_results TYPE slctr_tables_keys.",
    "  DATA: short_sellist LIKE vimsellist OCCURS 10,",
    "        short_sel LIKE vimsellist, selindex TYPE i, selnumber TYPE i,",
    "        selcut TYPE i, selpieces TYPE i, viewlen TYPE i.",
    "",
    "  FIELD-SYMBOLS: <field> TYPE ANY.",
    "",
    "  TYPES: scpr_c64(64)   TYPE c,",
    "       scpr_c128(128)   TYPE c,",
    "       scpr_c256(256)   TYPE c,",
    "       scpr_c512(512)   TYPE c,",
    "       scpr_c1024(1024) TYPE c,",
    "       scpr_c2048(2048) TYPE c,",
    "       scpr_c4096(4096) TYPE c,",
    "       scpr_c8192(8192) TYPE c,",
    "       scpr_c64s        TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scpr_c64,",
    "       scpr_c128s       TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scpr_c128,",
    "       scpr_c256s       TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scpr_c256,",
    "       scpr_c512s       TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scpr_c512,",
    "       scpr_c1024s      TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scpr_c1024,",
    "       scpr_c2048s      TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scpr_c2048,",
    "       scpr_c4096s      TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scpr_c4096,",
    "       scpr_c8192s      TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scpr_c8192.",
    "",
    "  DATA: wa_tot64   TYPE scpr_c64,",
    "        wa_tot128  TYPE scpr_c128,",
    "        wa_tot256  TYPE scpr_c256,",
    "        wa_tot512  TYPE scpr_c512,",
    "        wa_tot1024 TYPE scpr_c1024,",
    "        wa_tot2048 TYPE scpr_c2048,",
    "        wa_tot4096 TYPE scpr_c4096,",
    "        wa_tot8192 TYPE scpr_c8192,",
    "        f_it_tlibg LIKE TABLE OF tlibg WITH HEADER LINE, \"#EC NEEDED",
    "*        f_wa_tlibg TYPE LINE OF f_it_tlibg,",
    "        it_tot64   TYPE scpr_c64s,",
    "        it_tot128  TYPE scpr_c128s,",
    "        it_tot256  TYPE scpr_c256s,",
    "        it_tot512  TYPE scpr_c512s,",
    "        it_tot1024 TYPE scpr_c1024s,",
    "        it_tot2048 TYPE scpr_c2048s,",
    "        it_tot4096 TYPE scpr_c4096s,",
    "        it_tot8192 TYPE scpr_c8192s.",
    "* Datencontainer und Arbeitsbereiche vorbereiten",
    "  FIELD-SYMBOLS: <it_tmp_data>     TYPE STANDARD TABLE,",
    "                 <wa_it_tmp_data>  TYPE ANY,",
    "                 <wax_it_tmp_data> TYPE ANY,",
    "                 <data_wax>        TYPE ANY.",
    "",
    "  IF x_header IS REQUESTED. DESCRIBE TABLE x_header LINES h_ix. ENDIF.",
    "  IF x_namtab IS REQUESTED. DESCRIBE TABLE x_namtab LINES n_ix. ENDIF.",
    "  IF NOT ( x_header IS REQUESTED AND x_namtab IS REQUESTED ) OR",
    "     h_ix EQ 0 OR n_ix EQ 0.",
    "* Get nametab for view/table",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'VIEW_GET_DDIC_INFO'",
    "      EXPORTING",
    "        viewname = view_name",
    "      TABLES",
    "        sellist  = isellist",
    "        x_header = header",
    "        x_namtab = namtab",
    "      EXCEPTIONS",
    "        OTHERS   = 1.",
    "    CASE sy-subrc.",
    "      WHEN 0.",
    "      WHEN 1.",
    "        MESSAGE i383 WITH view_name",
    "                RAISING no_viewmaint_tool.",
    "    ENDCASE.",
    "* check if the function group exist.",
    "    READ TABLE header INDEX 1.",
    "    SELECT SINGLE * FROM tlibg INTO f_it_tlibg",
    "        WHERE area = header-area.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "      MESSAGE e037 WITH header-area",
    "                   RAISING no_functiongroup.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    IF dba_sellist IS REQUESTED.       \"adjust both sellists",
    "      DESCRIBE TABLE isellist LINES dd_selcond_lines.",
    "      DESCRIBE TABLE dba_sellist LINES usr_selcond_lines.",
    "      IF dd_selcond_lines EQ 0 AND usr_selcond_lines NE 0.",
    "        MOVE x TO header-selection.",
    "        MODIFY header INDEX 1.",
    "      ELSEIF dd_selcond_lines NE 0 AND usr_selcond_lines NE 0.",
    "        IF header-subsetflag EQ x AND  \"deal with subsets only if this",
    "           without_subset EQ space.    \"is requested",
    "          LOOP AT isellist WHERE ddic EQ s. \"dd subsets already known",
    "            LOOP AT dba_sellist WHERE viewfield EQ isellist-viewfield",
    "                                  AND ( ( negation EQ space AND",
    "                                          operator EQ 'EQ' ) OR",
    "                                        ( negation NE space AND",
    "                                          operator EQ 'NE' ) ).",
    "              MOVE: dba_sellist-value TO isellist-value,",
    "                    isellist-ddic TO dba_sellist-ddic.",
    "              MODIFY dba_sellist.",
    "              SUBTRACT 1 FROM usr_selcond_lines.",
    "            ENDLOOP.",
    "            IF sy-subrc EQ 0.",
    "              IF isellist-value EQ space.",
    "                isellist-initial = 'X'.",
    "              ENDIF.",
    "              MODIFY isellist.",
    "            ENDIF.",
    "          ENDLOOP.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        IF usr_selcond_lines NE 0.",
    "          READ TABLE isellist INDEX dd_selcond_lines.",
    "          MOVE 'AND' TO isellist-and_or.",
    "          MODIFY isellist INDEX dd_selcond_lines.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      IF usr_selcond_lines NE 0.",
    "        LOOP AT dba_sellist WHERE ddic EQ space.",
    "          READ TABLE namtab WITH KEY dba_sellist-viewfield. \"#EC WARNOK",
    "          IF sy-subrc EQ 0.",
    "            dba_sellist-tabix = sy-tabix.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "          isellist = dba_sellist.",
    "          IF isellist-value EQ space AND",
    "           ( isellist-negation EQ space AND isellist-operator EQ 'EQ' OR",
    "             isellist-negation EQ 'NOT' AND isellist-operator EQ 'NE' ).",
    "            isellist-initial = 'X'.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "          APPEND isellist.",
    "        ENDLOOP.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ELSE.",
    "* Nametab given from calling program",
    "    namtab[] = x_namtab[].",
    "    header[] = x_header[].",
    "    READ TABLE header INDEX 1.",
    "    SELECT SINGLE * FROM tlibg INTO f_it_tlibg",
    "        WHERE area = header-area.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "      MESSAGE e383 WITH header-area",
    "                   RAISING no_functiongroup.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    IF dba_sellist IS REQUESTED.",
    "      isellist[] = dba_sellist[].",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    READ TABLE header INDEX 1.",
    "    IF header-after_keyc = 0.",
    "* Called by compare tool by remote. Delivered header-info frozen at",
    "* release 3.1:",
    "* add missing header-information.",
    "      PERFORM get_aligned_offset_char(saplsvix)",
    "                                     USING header-keylen",
    "                                     CHANGING header-after_keyc.",
    "      PERFORM get_aligned_offset_char(saplsvix)",
    "                                     USING header-textkeylen",
    "                                     CHANGING header-aft_txtkc.",
    "      PERFORM get_aligned_offset_char(saplsvix)",
    "                                     USING header-tablen",
    "                                     CHANGING header-after_tabc.",
    "      PERFORM get_aligned_offset_char(saplsvix)",
    "                                     USING header-texttablen",
    "                                     CHANGING header-aft_txttbc.",
    "      MODIFY header INDEX 1.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF with_authority_check NE space.    \"process authority check",
    "    READ TABLE header INDEX 1.",
    "    IF header-newgener EQ space. \"4.5A: support individual auth. check",
    "      CALL FUNCTION 'VIEW_AUTHORITY_CHECK'",
    "        EXPORTING",
    "          view_action                    = 'S'    \"check only show auth.",
    "          view_name                      = view_name",
    "          no_warning_for_clientindep     = 'X'     \"no warning requested",
    "        CHANGING",
    "          org_crit_inst                  = org_crit_inst",
    "        EXCEPTIONS",
    "          table_not_found                = 5",
    "          no_authority                   = 8",
    "          no_clientindependent_authority = 9",
    "          no_linedependent_authority     = 10.",
    "      CASE sy-subrc.",
    "        WHEN 0.",
    "         IF org_crit_inst IS REQUESTED AND NOT org_crit_inst IS INITIAL",
    "                AND check_linedep_auth <> space.",
    "* ISELLIST in agreement with authority?",
    "            IF without_subset NE space.",
    "* ignore subsets",
    "              DELETE isellist WHERE ddic EQ 'S'.",
    "              DESCRIBE TABLE isellist.",
    "              IF sy-tfill GT 0.",
    "                CLEAR isellist-and_or.",
    "                MODIFY isellist INDEX sy-tfill TRANSPORTING and_or.",
    "              ENDIF.",
    "            ENDIF.",
    "            CALL METHOD org_crit_inst->check_oc_auth_vim_sellist",
    "              EXPORTING",
    "                sellist = isellist[]",
    "                action  = '03'",
    "              EXCEPTIONS",
    "                no_auth = 1.",
    "            IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "              MESSAGE ID sy-msgid TYPE 'E' NUMBER sy-msgno",
    "               WITH sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4",
    "               RAISING no_auth_for_sel.",
    "            ENDIF.",
    "          ELSE.",
    "            CLEAR org_crit_inst.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "        WHEN 5.",
    "          MESSAGE i028 WITH view_name RAISING no_viewmaint_tool.",
    "        WHEN 9.",
    "          MESSAGE ID 'TB' TYPE 'I' NUMBER 109       \"no cli-indep auth",
    "                  RAISING no_authority.",
    "        WHEN 8.",
    "          MESSAGE i053 RAISING no_authority.",
    "        WHEN 10.",
    "          IF check_linedep_auth <> space.",
    "            MESSAGE e755 RAISING no_authority",
    "             WITH sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4.",
    "*   Sie haben keine zeilenbezogene Anzeigeberechtigung für diese Tabelle",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "      ENDCASE.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF without_subset NE space.          \"ignore selections",
    "    header-subsetflag = space.",
    "    MODIFY header INDEX 1 TRANSPORTING subsetflag.",
    "    DELETE isellist WHERE ddic EQ 'S'.",
    "    DESCRIBE TABLE isellist.",
    "    IF sy-tfill GT 0.",
    "      CLEAR isellist-and_or.",
    "      MODIFY isellist INDEX sy-tfill TRANSPORTING and_or.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF without_exits NE space.           \"ignore exits",
    "    READ TABLE header INDEX 1.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_NAMETAB_GET'",
    "      EXPORTING",
    "        tabname   = 'VIMDESC'",
    "      TABLES",
    "        x031l_tab = ix031l.",
    "    LOOP AT ix031l WHERE fieldname CP 'FRM*'.",
    "      ASSIGN COMPONENT ix031l-fieldname OF STRUCTURE header TO <field>.",
    "      CLEAR <field>.",
    "    ENDLOOP.",
    "    MODIFY header INDEX 1.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "* Tabellennamen bestimmen",
    "  IF header-bastab EQ space.           \"view",
    "    CLEAR: tot_name, ext_name.",
    "    CONCATENATE: header-maintview tot_suffix INTO tot_name,",
    "                 header-maintview ext_suffix INTO ext_name.",
    "  ELSE.                                \"table",
    "    READ TABLE header INDEX 1.",
    "    IF header-bastab EQ space OR header-texttbexst EQ space.",
    "    table_length = header-after_tabc / cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize.",
    "      x_table_length = table_length + 2.",
    "    ELSE.",
    "      table_length = ( header-after_tabc + header-aft_txttbc )",
    "       / cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize.",
